title: Solana Moves Early to Defend Blockchain Security Against Quantum Computing
subTitle:
The Solana Foundation has taken a significant early step toward protecting its blockchain from future quantum computing threats by successfully deploying post-quantum digital signatures on a Solana testnet. While large-scale quantum computers capable of breaking today’s cryptography do not yet exist, Solana’s leadership believes waiting until that moment would be a mistake. Instead, the network is choosing preparation over reaction.

This initiative follows a detailed quantum risk assessment conducted in collaboration with Project Eleven, a firm known for its expertise in post-quantum cryptography and digital asset migration strategies. The assessment explored how future quantum advancements could affect Solana’s validators, user wallets, cryptographic assumptions, and overall network security. The outcome was clear: preparing early is both possible and practical.

As part of this collaboration, Project Eleven implemented a fully functional post-quantum signature system on Solana’s testnet. The deployment proved that quantum-resistant transactions can already operate at scale using today’s technology. This directly challenges the long-standing belief that quantum-safe blockchains remain a distant theoretical concept rather than an achievable reality.

According to the Solana Foundation, long-term security is a core responsibility of the network. Leadership emphasized that Solana must remain resilient not only in the present market cycle but decades into the future. This forward-looking mindset aligns with Solana’s broader development culture, which continues to focus on rapid execution, including the release of a second validator client and advanced consensus improvements planned for this year.

Project Eleven’s CEO described Solana’s approach as proactive risk management. Rather than waiting for quantum computing to become an urgent crisis, Solana evaluated the threat early, asked difficult technical questions, and acted decisively. The results, he noted, show that post-quantum security on Solana is already feasible without sacrificing scalability.

The timing of this move is notable, as the crypto industry remains divided on how close quantum computing is to posing a real threat. Some experts believe meaningful risk could emerge within the next several years, while others argue that true danger will only appear once quantum machines reach military-grade performance levels, possibly in the 2030s. Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson has previously downplayed near-term risks, warning that quantum-resistant cryptography could introduce heavy computational costs. In contrast, Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has taken a more urgent stance, cautioning that both Ethereum and Bitcoin may face cryptographic vulnerabilities before the decade ends if preparations are delayed.

Solana’s testnet deployment reflects a broader shift across the blockchain industry toward future-proof security. As networks increasingly evaluate migration paths, emerging standards, and post-quantum cryptographic primitives, early experiments like Solana’s suggest that many technical barriers are already being removed. While quantum computers capable of breaking blockchain encryption are not yet operational, the momentum toward quantum-safe infrastructure is accelerating.

Whether the quantum threat arrives in two years or ten, the direction is clear. Blockchain networks are entering a new phase where long-term cryptographic resilience matters as much as performance and scalability. By acting early, Solana has positioned itself among the first major networks to treat quantum security not as a distant concern, but as a present responsibility.    #Eth

title: (P1) Lý Do Tôi Không Giàu Nhanh Với Crypto — Nhưng Tôi Còn Ở Lại Sau 8 Năm ?
subTitle:
Mình tham gia thị trường khi mua BTC với giá 2000 USD tháng 4/2017 trên Poloniex và Bittrex, khi mà sàn Binance này còn chưa ra đời.
Sau 8 năm trong thị trường crypto, mình không còn nhớ nổi đã trải qua bao nhiêu lần hưng phấn rồi tuyệt vọng. Có những chu kỳ mình tưởng như đã “hiểu được thị trường”, chỉ cần mở chart là thấy cơ hội.
Rồi cũng chính thị trường dạy cho mình bài học ngược lại — rằng không ai thực sự kiểm soát được nó. Thứ thay đổi lớn nhất không phải số dư tài khoản, mà là cách mình nhìn tiền, nhìn rủi ro và nhìn chính bản thân.
Mình đã từng FOMO, từng all-in, từng thức trắng đêm canh nến, từng đúng xu hướng nhưng vẫn thua vì không quản trị được tâm lý.
Qua nhiều chu kỳ tăng – giảm, mình hiểu ra một điều : sống sót trong thị trường đã là một dạng thành công và lợi nhuận bền vững chỉ đến khi mình thôi cố chứng minh mình thông minh hơn thị trường, bắt đầu học cách đi cùng nó.
Sau 1 năm 2025 đầy biến động của thị trường, câu hỏi mình nghe nhiều nhất không còn là “Coin nào sắp xxx?”  nữa mà là " Khi nào về được bờ ".
Các bạn newbie hãy lựa sức mà " bơi " trong thị trường này. " Sức yếu " thì bơi gần bờ đánh bắt cá nhỏ, tích lũy kinh nghiệm. Vốn nhỏ thì tham vọng nhỏ lại, lòng tham bớt đi.
Hãy chịu khó học hỏi rồi trải nghiệm với vốn nhỏ trước, đừng đi khắp nơi hỏi kèo làm gì. Đó không phải lựa chọn bền vững và sáng suốt, bạn hãy tập bước đi bằng đôi chân mình.
Các bạn cần học đầu tiên đó là kỷ luật và quản lý vốn trước. Vì còn tiền còn vốn là còn cơ hội, còn động lực để học hỏi
Một trong các phương pháp quản lý vốn mình thích đó là : 2-5-3
Phương pháp này chia vốn thành 3 phần : 
25% để bắt đầu50% để phòng thủ và trung bình giá25% để tấn công khi xu hướng rõ ràng
Bước 1: Vào nhẹ để còn thở (25%)
Khi quyết định tham gia một đồng coin, mình chỉ dùng 25% vốn cho lệnh đầu tiên, không all-in, không FOMO.
Mục tiêu duy nhất của bước này là:  có vị thế, nhưng vẫn ngủ ngon. Khi giá rung lắc, mình quan sát thị trường với tâm thế chủ động, thay vì hoảng loạn vì đã “đặt cược cả cuộc đời”.
Bước 2: Trung bình giá có kỷ luật (50%)
Đây là phần vốn giúp mình sống sót qua những pha thị trường “vả liên hoàn”. Mỗi khi giá giảm khoảng 7–10%, mình giải ngân thêm một phần nhỏ.

Không mua theo cảm xúc, không mua vì sợ lỡ tàu.
Cảm giác rất khác so với all-in, giá càng giảm → mình càng chủ động, không hoảng.
Bước 3: Chỉ mua mạnh khi xu hướng xác nhận (25%)
Phần vốn cuối cùng, mình chỉ dùng khi thị trường đã tự chứng minh:
Giá phá kháng cự quan trọngKhối lượng tăngXu hướng duy trì ổn định
Lúc này, mua thêm không phải đu đỉnh, mà là đi theo dòng tiền.
Và điều quan trọng nhất là bạn không được tham x10, x20 mà mua coin rác. Hãy chỉ mua coin có nền tảng tốt, mua trong các đợt điều chỉnh sâu của thị trường. Hãy để công việc bới rác tìm vàng cho người khác làm. Mình chỉ làm công việc đánh bóng vàng kiếm cơm an toàn thôi.

title: Year 2026: Institutions Will Absorb All New BTC, ETH and SOL Supply, Warns Bitwise
subTitle:
Bitwise, the world’s largest crypto index fund manager with more than $15 billion in assets under management, has released a bold prediction: institutional demand for crypto ETFs will exceed the total new supply of Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana in 2026.

If this scenario unfolds, the market may face a severe supply imbalance that could fuel significant price appreciation.
According to Matt Hougan (Bitwise CIO) and Ryan Rasmussen (Head of Research), the long-term influx of institutional capital is the primary reason why newly issued tokens may no longer be able to meet future demand.

Institutional Buying to Surpass New Supply – A Potential “Supply Squeeze”
In its latest outlook for 2026, Bitwise states that newly created BTC, ETH, and SOL supply will fall short of what institutional investors purchase through ETFs.

New supply refers to tokens entering circulation through mining, staking rewards, or protocol issuance.
If ETF demand continues to grow at this pace, the market could experience:
a structural liquidity shortage (supply squeeze)persistent upward price pressurefundamental change in the behavior of the three largest crypto assets
Bitwise stresses that this is a prediction, not a guaranteed outcome.

ETFs Already Buy More BTC Than the Market Produces
Since the launch of spot Bitcoin ETFs in 2024, the market has shifted dramatically.

During this period, ETFs have purchased 710,777 BTC, while miners produced only 363,047 BTC.

Demand is therefore nearly double the rate of supply, showing that the trend is already underway.
Traditional giants such as Morgan Stanley and Merrill Lynch have enabled their clients to include crypto in their portfolios, pushing the market firmly into institutional territory.
Bitwise expects over 100 new crypto ETFs to be launched in the United States in 2026.

Bitcoin Could Break Its Historic Four-Year Cycle
Bitwise also predicts that 2026 will be a turning point for Bitcoin:

BTC may break the traditional four-year halving cycle for the first time.
Historically, Bitcoin’s behavior has been shaped by:
halving eventsretail speculationcyclical momentum
However, Bitwise argues that institutional capital—especially through spot ETFs—will become the dominant force shaping the market, overriding these earlier patterns.
As a result, Bitcoin may begin behaving more like a mature macro asset, similar to gold, rather than a purely cyclical one.

Regulation Paves the Way for Massive Adoption
2025 brought a major regulatory shift. The SEC streamlined the approval process for spot crypto ETFs, reducing timelines and creating a predictable, repeatable framework for issuers.

As a result, Bitcoin and crypto ETFs shifted rapidly from niche financial instruments to mainstream portfolio-building products.
Bitwise believes this institutional infrastructure will solidify crypto’s position within long-term investment strategies.

What This Means for the Market
If ETFs truly purchase more than 100% of new BTC, ETH, and SOL supply, the crypto market may enter an era defined by:
chronic liquidity shortageslong-term upward pressure on pricesreduced reliance on retail speculationdeeper integration with institutional capital
According to Bitwise, 2026 could mark the year when crypto transitions from a speculative asset class into a central component of global financial infrastructure.

Bearish Turn: Focus on the Potential Risks of the Bank of Japan's Rate Hike

Recently, I have turned bearish on the market, with a core focus on just one thing: the Bank of Japan. On Thursday, the Bank of Japan will announce its interest rate decision. Although many in the market haven't paid much attention, the recent decline in Bitcoin has already reflected the expectation that "Japan may raise interest rates". This is not just about Bitcoin's downturn; even the Nikkei index has seen declines during the same period, indicating that the same funding chain is contracting in sync. #BankOfJapanInterestRateHike #BTC

What the market is truly worried about is not whether "they will raise that little bit of interest," but whether yen carry trades will be forced to unwind. For the past few years, the yen has been close to zero interest rates, and even negative rates, making it the cheapest financing tool globally. The funding path is straightforward: borrow yen, exchange for dollars, and then invest in U.S. stocks, tech stocks, or even high-volatility assets like Bitcoin.

This arbitrage operation has one prerequisite — the yen must continue to weaken. Once the Bank of Japan signals a rate hike, or merely shifts to a hawkish stance, the yen will strengthen, borrowing costs will rise, and funds will immediately face burdens, with the only options being to cut positions and repay debts.

The contraction of this arbitrage chain will not only affect the yen; it will directly pressure the prices of high-risk assets such as U.S. stocks, tech stocks, and Bitcoin. The market is therefore concerned that we may see a repeat of the chain reaction in July and August 2024 — a cross-market synchronized decline.

So, while I remain optimistic about Bitcoin's long-term value, the safety of risk assets is difficult to guarantee before the Bank of Japan's interest rate hike is fully implemented. The macro environment is changing extremely rapidly, and if there's a misstep, it may be too late to retreat.

市场真正担心的，不是“加不加那一点利息”，而是日元套利交易是否会被迫平仓。过去几年，日元长期接近零利率，甚至负利率，日元成为全球最便宜的融资工具。资金路径简单明了：借日元，换美元，再投资美股、科技股甚至比特币等高波动资产。

这种套利操作有一个前提——日元必须持续走弱。一旦日本央行释放加息信号，或者仅仅是态度转鹰，日元走强，借贷成本上升，资金立刻面临负担，选择只能是砍仓、还钱。

这种套利链条的收缩，不仅仅会影响日元，它将直接压迫美股、科技股、比特币等高风险资产的价格。市场因此担心会重演2024年7、8月的连锁反应——跨市场共振下跌。

巨鲸出手，ETH先扛住了
在市场剧烈波动时，流动性强的资产往往会最先承压，而以太坊最近正好印证了这一点。多名巨鲸集中减持，但ETH并没有立刻崩盘，反而进入了震荡整理阶段。
截至目前，#ETH 价格在2957美元附近徘徊。虽然短时间内抛压不小，但价格并未出现失控式下跌，说明市场正在消化这些筹码，只是下行风险仍然存在。
鲸鱼集中抛售，压力不小
链上数据显示，抛压主要来自几位重量级地址。与Lido Finance早期成员、P2P.org创始人相关的钱包，在1小时内卖出了14585枚ETH，价值约4270万美元。

与此同时，另外两名巨鲸合计抛售了14000枚ETH，其中一位通过DEX卖出10000枚，另一位则向中心化交易所转移并出售了4000枚。短时间内超过28500枚ETH流入市场，直接拉高了短期卖压。
价格没崩，说明在“吸筹”？
有意思的是，面对如此规模的抛售，ETH的价格表现却相对克制。当前价格仍运行在上升趋势支撑位上方，同时处于50%—61%斐波那契回撤区间，这本身就是一个容易出现多空博弈的区域。
多次回踩2882美元附近都被买盘接住，下跌空间被明显限制。不过市场动能并不强，RSI目前在36附近，说明需求偏弱，但还没到全面失控的地步。
流动性集中在3000美元上方
从清算热力图来看，3000美元上方仍然聚集着大量流动性。一旦抛压减弱，这一区域可能会对价格形成“吸引效应”，推动ETH向上试探。

但反过来说，如果价格跌破61%斐波那契回撤位，当前结构就会明显转弱，下一步可能回测2607美元附近的需求区，这将是更关键的一道防线。
分歧阶段：出货还是建仓？
目前的市场状态，更像是短期分散与长期布局并存。部分大户选择减仓，但价格并未被砸穿，说明下方承接力仍在。
想要真正扭转市场情绪，ETH仍需重新站上3462—3600美元区间。在那之前，行情大概率会继续围绕支撑和阻力反复拉扯，双向波动会比较频繁。

接下来重点看哪里？
短期最关键的位置，依然是2882美元附近。这里如果继续守住，ETH还有震荡向上的空间；一旦失守，下方2607美元将成为下一道重要观察位。同时也可以留意RSI是否企稳，判断买盘是否重新回流。
总结一句话
巨鲸抛售已经发生，但ETH暂时顶住了压力。守住2882美元是关键，跌破则需防进一步回调。在方向明确之前，震荡和波动仍是主旋律。#巨鲸动向

Mistakes I Made as a Beginner Trader So You Don’t....
When I started trading, I thought profits would come fast and easily. I believed every green candle meant “buy now” and every influencer knew the future. That mindset cost me money, time, and a lot of stress. If you’re new, learning from these mistakes can save you from the same pain.
One of my biggest mistakes was trading without a plan. I entered trades just because the price was moving fast or someone said a coin would pump. I had no clear entry, no stop loss, and no exit target. When the market moved against me, I panicked and made things worse. A simple plan would have protected my capital.
Another mistake was risking too much on one trade. I used large positions hoping to get rich quickly. One bad move wiped out days or weeks of gains. Over time, I learned that protecting capital is more important than chasing big profits. Small, controlled risk keeps you in the game.
I also ignored stop losses in the beginning. I told myself, “It will come back.” Sometimes it did, but many times it didn’t. Losses kept growing because I refused to accept I was wrong. Using a stop loss is not weakness. It’s discipline and survival.
Overtrading was another problem. I felt I had to trade every move to make money. This led to poor decisions, high fees, and emotional exhaustion. The market doesn’t pay you for activity; it pays you for patience. Waiting for good setups changed everything for me.
I spent too much time chasing pumps. I bought after big green candles, thinking I was early, but usually I was late. Smart money buys quietly and sells when the crowd gets excited. Learning to wait for pullbacks helped me avoid unnecessary losses.
Finally, I underestimated emotions. Fear made me sell too early, and greed made me hold too long. Trading is not just charts; it’s a mental game. Controlling emotions and staying calm during wins and losses is a skill that takes time.

title: Using Your Crypto Without Letting It Go: How USDf Changes the Liquidity Story
subTitle:
One of the more frustrating things about the world of crypto has always been the issue of liquidity. You believe in the assets, you want to hold them long-term, but the world doesn’t wait. Bills come due, business opportunities come along, and all of a sudden, things don’t wait. The traditional solution to this problem has been painful: sell the crypto or lock it away and hope for the best. #FalconFinance s USDf presents an alternative.
USDf is not built to excite or persuade through hype. It is straightforward: to enable the use of the value of your assets without having to surrender the assets themselves. You no longer need to sell your #ETH , your #BTC , or your tokenized real-world assets but use them as collateral to mint a stable on-chain dollar in the form of USDf. Your assets remain with you, but the spending money is now USDf.
“The idea behind USDf is respect for conviction over time. Many people who hold cryptos do not want to sell out because they cannot meet short-term financial needs. With USDf, your money functions as your financial backbone. You release money while maintaining benefits from potential expansion in the future. It is such a small but revolutionary concept because DeFi interacts with people in terms of panic sales changing to planned liquidity in DeFi platforms."
What distinguishes Falcon Finance is its universal collateral model. In most existing lending platforms, the choice of assets is strictly limited. Falcon Finance breaks these barriers and provides wider opportunities. "Cryptocurrencies, stock tokens, real property, business inventory, and other ‘real-world’ assets can all be used." What is essential is if it has "provable value." That is crucial, primarily for users who do not keep their wealth "only in cryptocurrency."
Safety is where USDf operates rather quietly and distinctly among the market protocols. It doesn’t provide any leverage; rather, it follows overcollateralization, meaning it will allow users to mint fewer tokens than the total value of the asset they have and lock into the pool. Of course, this is done to safeguard the users in case of any drastic decline in market value. Falcon’s response to the change would not result in immediate liquidation but would rather provide time to act accordingly when warnings are sent to users relating to the change in market value of the asset.
USDf can also be used elsewhere other than on Falcon Finance. Once it is minted, it works like regular on-chain cash. It can be spent or exchanged or utilized on the DeFi platforms. It will not remain constrained on one network. This thing matters because liquidity cannot work well if it gets stagnant.
Sustainability is another important aspect. Falcon doesn’t promise the moon in terms of return on investment. Returns result from activity that is more or less based on staking collateral, mint/burn fees from circulating USDf, and earnings from more conventional assets. This is just the kind of system which should be expected from a financial tool. It’s not exactly thrilling, but more so because it’s reliable.
For SMEs, long-term holders, and asset owners, USD f delivers a paradigm shift. Assets are no longer left idle, pending ‘the right time.’ They remain quietly in the background, serving a need, yet not forcing a dilemma. This is particularly significant when real-world assets are integrated into DeFi, thereby aligning on-chain finance with real-world economy.
Nevertheless, the USDf is not without its flaws. Care must still be exercised on the part of the user regarding the collateral and risks. “Smart contracts and laws” always require focus. However, in relation to the former option of “Sell or Suffer,” USDf does seem like an advancement. #FalconFinance  isn’t setting out to revolutionize the crypto culture in one night. Rather, it’s doing the more constructive activity of making the world of crypto more livable. The power of USDf translates the act of believing to one of flexibility and the action of holding to one of functionality. Perhaps it will be the greatest DeFi evolution in the last few years for many users.

وأوضح الموقع أن العوامل الاقتصادية الخارجية ساهمت في تعزيز المشاعر السلبية، حيث أظهرت بيانات سوق العمل الأمريكية المؤجلة سابقا بسبب الإغلاق الحكومي خسارة صافية للوظائف على مدى الشهرين الماضيين، كما شهدت صناديق الاستثمار المتداولة (ETFs) الأمريكية لعملتي بيتكوين $BTC  وإثيريوم ETH خسائر صافية متجمعة بلغت ٥٨٢ مليون دولار يوم الاثنين، وهو أكبر انسحاب منذ ٢٠ نوفمبر.
وسجلت صناديق عملة إثيريوم #ETH  تحديدا خروج ٢٢٤.٨ مليون دولار في اليوم الثالث على التوالي من عمليات السحب، وعلى الرغم من الأخبار الإيجابية مثل إطلاق JPMorgan أول صندوق سوق نقدي معرض على سلسلة عملة إثيريوم ETH، إلا أن هذا لم يكن كافيا لدعم السعر الذي لمس منخفضاً عند ٢٨٧٤ دولاراً.

مسار سعر عملة إثيريوم ETH والتحديات الفنية الراهنة:
ويتداول سعر عملة إثيريوم ETH عند ٢٩١٨ دولارا، مسجلا انخفاضا بنسبة ٦.٩٣٪ خلال الـ٢٤ ساعة الماضية و٦.٣٦٪ على أساس أسبوعي، وتشهد عملة إثيريوم ETH تراجعا مطردا منذ وصوله لقمة عند ٣٤٧٧ دولارا في ١٠ ديسمبر، حيث سجل خسائر في خمسة من آخر ستة أيام متضمنا اليوم.
ويضع هذا الهبوط المستمر عملة إثيريوم ETH تحت ضغط فني كبير، مع غياب أي علامات انعكاس قريبة في المدى القصير، ويحتاج المشترون لدفع السعر مرة أخرى فوق مستوى ٣٠٠٠ دولار واستعادته كدعم لتجنب استمرار الهبوط نحو مناطق دعم أعمق.

المشاهدات الاقتصادية الحاسمة والأسبوع الحاسم:
وأشار الموقع إلى أن السوق يترقب حدثا رئيسيا هذا الأسبوع يتمثل في إصدار تقير مؤشر أسعار المستهلك لشهر نوفمبر يوم الخميس، والمتوقع أن يظهر ارتفاع معدل التضخم العام إلى ٣.١٪ على أساس سنوي.
كما سيصدر في نفس اليوم أحدث أعداد طالبي إعانات البطالة الأسبوعية، ويقدر المتداولون حاليا احتمالا بنسبة ٧٥٪ أن يحافظ مجلس الاحتياطي الاتحادي (البنك المركزي الأمريكي) على أسعار الفائدة دون تغيير في اجتماع يناير المقبل، وهو ما يتوافق مع حالة عدم اليقين السائدة في الأسواق، وستكون ردة فعل السوق على هذه البيانات حاسمة في تحديد المسار القصير للأصل الرقمي والقطاع ككل.

title: JP Morgan's Ethereum bet faces a key Price Test _ Bounce or Further Drop
subTitle:
JPMorgan’s Ethereum Bet Faces a Key Price Test — Bounce or Further Drop?
$ETH 
Ethereum has been among the weakest major cryptocurrencies during the recent market selloff. ETH is down more than 6% in the last 24 hours, pushing weekly losses close to 9%, as macro uncertainty and liquidations continue to pressure the market.

Despite this weakness, a major institutional update has brought Ethereum back into focus. JPMorgan has launched its first tokenized money market fund on Ethereum, seeded with $100 million. The big question now is whether this news can help ETH stabilize — or if technical pressure will push prices lower.

Institutional Support vs. Technical Pressure

JPMorgan’s move highlights Ethereum’s growing role as institutional infrastructure. The new tokenized fund, called MONY, is being launched through JPMorgan’s digital asset platform, starting with a $100 million allocation before expanding to external investors.

From a long-term view, this strengthens Ethereum’s fundamentals. In the short term, however, the chart remains fragile. ETH is nearing a bearish EMA crossover on the daily timeframe, with the 100-day EMA close to slipping below the 200-day EMA — a signal that momentum is weakening.

With ETH struggling to hold the $2,910 support zone, even strong headlines may fail to trigger a sustained rally unless key resistance levels are reclaimed.

On-Chain Data Keeps the Rebound Scenario Alive

On-chain metrics suggest a potential short-term bounce — but only if support holds. The percentage of Ethereum addresses in profit has dropped sharply since December 10, now sitting at its lowest level since early December.

Historically, similar drops in this metric have aligned with short-term rebounds. Earlier this month, comparable conditions preceded rallies of 10–14%. While this doesn’t guarantee a bounce, it indicates that selling pressure is entering zones where buyers previously stepped in.

Key ETH Levels to Watch

Ethereum is currently testing the critical $2,910 support. A daily close below this level would weaken the rebound case and open downside targets

Trong khi đó, đối thủ của bạn là cá mập, Market maker, thuật toán giao dịch. Họ luôn có nhiều vốn hơn, thông tin tốt hơn, cùng khả năng điều khiển thanh khoản. Còn bạn chỉ có phán đoán và cảm xúc.
Một sự thật ít người muốn nghe là phần lớn trader thua lỗ dù đoán đúng xu hướng.
Lý do bởi họ dùng đòn bẩy quá cao, không đặt stop-loss và DCA sai cách trong hợp đồng. Họ cháy tài khoản chỉ vì 1–2 cây nến quét
👉 Hợp đồng không giết bạn từ từ, nó kết liễu bạn rất nhanh.
Khi dùng đòn bẩy, một nhịp điều chỉnh nhỏ cũng khiến bạn hoảng loạn. Bạn bắt đầu dời stop-loss, gồng lỗ và có tâm lý trả thù thị trường. Lúc này, bạn không còn giao dịch theo chiến lược, mà giao dịch theo cảm xúc sinh tồn.
Vì sao người mới đặc biệt dễ chết với Futures?
Bởi vì họ muốn nhanh,muốn giàu sớm. Tin rằng chỉ cần "đúng hướng" là thắng
Nhưng thị trường không trả tiền cho người đoán đúng, mà trả tiền cho người sống sót đủ lâu.
Giao dịch hợp đồng chỉ phù hợp nếu bạn có kinh nghiệm spot lâu năm, hiểu rõ quản trị vốn, chấp nhận lợi nhuận đều và nhỏ. Bạn xem trading là nghề, không phải trò may rủi
Nó không phù hợp nếu bạn muốn làm giàu nhanh, vào lệnh theo cảm xúc và không chịu cắt lỗ. Tệ hơn là bạn dùng tiền không thể mất
👉 Sống sót qua nhiều chu kỳ quan trọng hơn ăn dày trong một chu kỳ.

title: Ethereum Market Update: Key Levels, Trend Outlook, and Practical Tactics for Vietnamese Investors
subTitle:
Ethereum is currently trading around the 2,900–3,000 USD zone, caught between strong support and heavy resistance, as the broader crypto market digests recent volatility and unwinds leverage. Price action is compressed, sentiment is cautious, but the medium‑term structure is still intact rather than clearly broken.
From a technical perspective, several important levels are in play right now:
- Short‑term support is clustering around 2,800–2,900 USD, an area where buyers have recently stepped in after aggressive long liquidations.
- The 3,000 USD region remains a psychological “magnet” and pivot; repeated tests show it is a decision zone, not a clean breakout yet.
- On the upside, 3,200–3,300 USD is the first serious resistance band; a daily close above ~3,300 USD would be the earliest sign of a renewed bullish leg toward 3,500 USD and beyond.
- Below, a clear break and acceptance under 2,800 USD would open risk toward deeper support around 2,500–2,600 USD and confirm that bears remain in control in the short term.
Short‑term momentum indicators are neutral to slightly bearish: ETH has pulled back over the past 1–2 weeks, RSI is in mid‑range rather than oversold, and price is consolidating under key moving averages and trendline resistance. That typically signals a “wait and see” zone: the trend is not strongly bullish, but downside follow‑through also isn’t confirmed unless support fails.
Macro and market context also matter:
- The expected year‑end “face‑melting” rally has not really materialized for either BTC or ETH, and both have given back a chunk of prior gains.
- Rising bond yields, risk‑off moves in global markets, and forced liquidations in overleveraged crypto positions have weighed on ETH.
- At the same time, Ethereum remains a core infrastructure asset with a large market cap and deep liquidity, which usually means it is among the first majors to attract capital again when risk appetite returns.
- On‑chain and positioning data show that the wave of selling from some larger holders is easing, suggesting the flush‑out phase may be closer to the end than the beginning, though that still needs confirmation in price.
For Vietnamese individual investors, the key is to translate this into clear, risk‑aware tactics:
1. For long‑term holders (6–24 months or more)
- Thesis: If you believe in Ethereum’s role in DeFi, L2s, tokenization, and future fee growth, this zone is more of an “accumulation band” than a panic zone, provided you size correctly.
- Strategy:
  - Consider staggered accumulation (DCA) between roughly 2,600–3,000 USD rather than trying to pick the exact bottom.
  - Avoid leverage; focus on spot positions only.
  - Define a time horizon and a maximum portfolio allocation to ETH (for example, 20–40% of your crypto allocation, depending on your risk profile), and stick to it.
2. For medium‑term swing traders (weeks to a few months)
- Bullish scenario:
  - Aggressive entries can look at partial buys near 2,800–2,900 USD with tight risk controls, betting that this support holds.
  - More conservative traders can wait for a clean daily close back above 3,200–3,300 USD before adding size, targeting 3,500–3,800 USD as the next major zone.
- Bearish scenario:
  - If price breaks and closes below 2,800 USD with volume, reduce long exposure; short‑term traders can even consider sidelining entirely until a new base forms, potentially closer to 2,500–2,600 USD.
- Risk management:
  - Define stop‑loss levels in advance (for example, a percentage below your entry or below clearly broken support).
  - Do not chase sudden spikes above resistance if they are not backed by strong volume and follow‑through.
3. For short‑term, high‑frequency traders
- Current conditions (tight consolidation under resistance, frequent long liquidations) favor disciplined range trading only for experienced traders with strict risk control.
- For most retail investors in Vietnam, this regime is more dangerous than attractive: slippage, fake breakouts, and funding‑rate swings can quickly erode capital.
- If you are not highly experienced, it is safer to focus on spot and medium‑term setups instead of constant intraday trading.
4. Position sizing and risk for Vietnamese investors
- Convert risk to VND terms before deciding position size, so you understand what a 10–20% move means for your personal finances.
- Ensure you have fiat reserves and are not forced to sell on drawdowns; forced selling is what turns temporary volatility into permanent loss.
- Beware of over‑reliance on local speculative communities or signal groups; combine on‑chain, technical, and macro views, and always verify information.
5. What would flip the structure convincingly bullish?
- A sustained daily close above roughly 3,300 USD, ideally accompanied by:
  - Rising volume.
  - Improving on‑chain flows (less exchange inflow, more long‑term holding).
  - A recovery in broader crypto sentiment, not just an ETH‑only spike.
- Under that scenario, upside paths toward 3,500–4,000 USD become more realistic for the next leg, though pullbacks on the way up would still be normal.
6. What would confirm a deeper correction?
- A decisive break below 2,800 USD, followed by rejection from below if ETH tries to retest this level.
- Continuation of risk‑off in global markets and renewed large liquidations in crypto.
- In that case, patience and capital preservation become the priority; wait for a new base and clear stabilization signs rather than blindly “buying the dip.”
Actionable checklist for now:
- If you are under‑allocated to ETH for the long term and comfortable with volatility, consider gradual DCA in the current band, accepting that short‑term drawdowns are possible.
- If you are already heavily exposed, prioritize protecting capital: avoid adding aggressively until ETH either:
  - Successfully defends 2,800–2,900 USD and reclaims 3,200–3,300 USD, or
  - Washes out toward lower supports and then stabilizes.
- Continuously review your thesis: you are not just trading a ticker; you are investing in the Ethereum ecosystem’s future usage, fee dynamics, and protocol evolution.
None of this is financial advice; it is a framework to help you think in probabilities, levels, and risk, so you can adapt it to your own situation as an investor in Vietnam.

title: (P2) Kinh Nghiệm Sống Sót Trong Thị Trường Sau 8 Năm ?
subTitle:
Như đã chia sẻ ở (P1), tôi bước vào thị trường crypto năm 2017 với sự tò mò. Bitcoin khi đó còn là một khái niệm mới mẻ, nhưng chỉ sau một thời gian ngắn, nó mang lại cho tôi khoản lợi nhuận lớn hơn bất kỳ công việc full-time nào trước đây. 
Lần đầu tiên trong đời, tôi cảm nhận rất rõ cảm giác tiền có thể tự sinh ra tiền. Sự hưng phấn đó khiến tôi tin rằng mình đã tìm ra con đường đúng.
Đầu năm 2018, tôi đưa ra một quyết định mà khi nhìn lại, nó vừa táo bạo vừa ngây thơ: nghỉ việc để đầu tư coin toàn thời gian. Tôi tin rằng nếu tập trung 100% cho thị trường, lợi nhuận sẽ còn lớn hơn nữa. 
Nhưng thị trường thì không vận hành theo niềm tin của bất kỳ ai. Crypto bắt đầu lao dốc, từng cây nến đỏ xuất hiện ngày này qua ngày khác. Lợi nhuận từng khiến tôi tự tin bốc hơi dần, còn tâm lý thì ngày càng nặng nề.
Stress không đến từ việc thua lỗ đơn thuần, mà đến từ cảm giác bị mắc kẹt. Toàn bộ vốn liếng của tôi nằm trong thị trường, không thể rút ra để chi tiêu, trong khi tôi lại không còn nguồn thu nhập nào khác. 
Mỗi quyết định đầu tư lúc đó đều bị chi phối bởi nỗi sợ: sợ bán xong thì giá bật lên, sợ giữ tiếp thì tài khoản còn giảm sâu hơn. Niềm tin cạn dần, sự bình tĩnh biến mất, và tôi nhận ra mình đã tự đặt cuộc sống lên một biểu đồ giá đầy biến động.
Chính giai đoạn khó khăn đó buộc tôi phải dừng lại và nhìn thẳng vào sai lầm của mình. Tôi hiểu rằng vấn đề không nằm ở crypto, cũng không hoàn toàn nằm ở thị trường giảm giá, mà nằm ở cách tôi quản trị cuộc sống và dòng tiền. Tôi đã đặt tất cả trứng vào một giỏ, và khi cái giỏ đó rung lắc, mọi thứ trở nên mất kiểm soát.
Bài học lớn nhất tôi rút ra là phải đa dạng hóa nguồn thu nhập và phân tách rõ ràng giữa tiền sống và tiền đầu tư. Crypto nên được coi là một kênh gia tăng tài sản trong dài hạn, chứ không phải nguồn sống duy nhất để phụ thuộc mỗi ngày. 
Khi có dòng tiền ngắn hạn để nuôi cuộc sống, tâm lý đầu tư sẽ nhẹ hơn rất nhiều. Không còn áp lực phải thắng nhanh, không còn nỗi sợ mỗi khi thị trường điều chỉnh, và những quyết định cũng trở nên tỉnh táo, kỷ luật hơn.
Sau cùng, tôi nhận ra rằng chỉ khi không còn phụ thuộc hoàn toàn vào thị trường, người ta mới thật sự đầu tư hiệu quả. Crypto không sai, thị trường cũng không có lỗi. Điều quan trọng là học cách sống sót qua chu kỳ, giữ được sự cân bằng giữa cuộc sống và đầu tư, để có thể đi đường dài mà không bị cuốn trôi bởi những cơn sóng ngắn hạn.
P/s : Tôi nhận được nhiều chia sẻ của các bạn làm grab, rồi dồn vốn tập trung all in đầu tư coin như kiểu đánh bạc, với hi vọng đổi đời. Thua lỗ khiến các bạn không thể tập trung lái xe. Như thế các bạn đã sai lầm, với số vốn quý giá của mình, thì các bạn càng phải học hỏi để đầu tư nghiêm túc. Hay vững tay lái chạy xe từ 7h_18h, từ 20h_23h tập trung học hỏi kinh nghiệm để đầu tư hiệu quả nhất, không all in bất kể thời điểm nào.

title: Solana Begins Quantum-Resistant Upgrade as Blockchain Security Enters a New Era
subTitle:
The Solana Foundation has taken a concrete and forward-looking step toward quantum-resistant blockchain security, officially deploying post-quantum digital signatures on a Solana testnet. The move places Solana among a growing group of major blockchain networks preparing for a future where quantum computing could challenge today’s cryptographic standards.
While large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers do not yet exist, the industry’s perception of risk is changing rapidly. What was once viewed as a distant, theoretical concern is increasingly being treated as a long-term existential threat that requires early preparation, not last-minute mitigation.
Solana Deploys Post-Quantum Signatures on Testnet
In an official announcement, the Solana Foundation confirmed that it has successfully deployed post-quantum signature schemes on a Solana testnet, marking the network’s first hands-on implementation of quantum-resistant cryptography.
> “Quantum computers aren’t here yet, but the Solana Foundation is preparing for the possibility. To that end, we’ve consulted with Project Eleven to assess our quantum readiness. We’re pleased to announce a first step, the deployment of post-quantum signatures on a Solana testnet,” the Foundation wrote.
This initiative follows a comprehensive quantum risk assessment conducted in partnership with Project Eleven, a firm specializing in post-quantum cryptography and migration strategies for digital asset networks.
The assessment examined how advances in quantum computing could impact:
Solana’s core protocol and cryptographic assumptions
Validator identity and signing security
User wallet safety
Long-term network resilience and upgrade paths
Rather than limiting the engagement to theory, Project Eleven went a step further by deploying a fully functioning post-quantum signature system on Solana’s testnet. The result demonstrates that end-to-end, quantum-resistant transactions are already feasible using today’s technology, challenging the notion that quantum-safe blockchains remain decades away from practical implementation.
From Theory to Practice: Why This Matters
For years, quantum risk discussions in crypto were largely academic. The assumption was that any meaningful threat would only arise far in the future, allowing networks to delay action.
Solana’s testnet deployment directly challenges that assumption.
By proving that post-quantum signatures can operate within a high-performance blockchain environment, Solana is showing that the technical barriers to quantum resistance are already beginning to fall.
Matt Sorg, Vice President of Technology at the Solana Foundation, emphasized the long-term responsibility behind the move:
> “Our responsibility is to ensure Solana remains secure not just today, but decades into the future.”
Sorg also highlighted that Solana’s culture of rapid development will continue, pointing to the planned release of a second validator client and a state-of-the-art consensus mechanism later this year — upgrades that will further strengthen decentralization and resilience alongside cryptographic innovation.
Project Eleven: Proactive Risk Management, Not Panic
Project Eleven CEO Alex Pruden framed Solana’s decision as a model for proactive risk management, rather than a reaction to immediate danger.
> “Solana didn’t wait for quantum computers to become a headline problem,” Pruden said. “They invested early, asked the hard questions, and took actionable steps today. The results show that post-quantum security on Solana is viable with today’s technology.”
This philosophy reflects a growing belief among security experts: migrating cryptographic systems takes years, not months. Waiting until quantum computers are capable of breaking classical cryptography could leave networks scrambling under pressure.
Early experimentation on testnets allows ecosystems to:
Measure real-world performance costs
Identify upgrade friction for validators and wallets
Develop safe migration paths for users
Align with emerging post-quantum standards
How Close Is the Quantum Threat? Industry Leaders Disagree
Solana’s announcement arrives amid intensifying debate over how soon quantum computing could threaten classical cryptographic systems used by blockchains like Bitcoin and Ethereum.
Recent academic research and government-backed programs suggest that the timeline may be shortening, with some estimates placing meaningful cryptographic risk within the next several years, rather than multiple decades.
However, industry views remain divided.
Charles Hoskinson, founder of Cardano, has repeatedly argued that quantum risk is often overstated. He suggests that serious threats will only emerge once military-grade quantum benchmarks are reached, potentially not until the 2030s. Hoskinson has also warned that quantum-resistant cryptography could introduce significant computational overhead and performance trade-offs.
On the other side of the debate, Ethereum has made quantum security a visible component of its long-term roadmap. Co-founder Vitalik Buterin has cautioned that both Ethereum and Bitcoin could face cryptographic pressure before the end of the decade if preparations are delayed.
This divergence of views highlights a core uncertainty: the exact timing of the threat is unknown, but the cost of being unprepared could be catastrophic.
A Broader Industry Shift Toward Quantum-Safe Infrastructure
Solana’s collaboration with Project Eleven reflects a broader shift across the blockchain industry toward future-proof security architectures.
Experts increasingly warn that blockchains relying solely on classical signature schemes may eventually face risks such as:
Theft of user funds through broken signatures
Spoofed validator or node identities
Deep system-level cryptographic failures that undermine consensus
Project Eleven has stated that it will continue working with Solana and other ecosystem participants as networks evaluate:
Migration strategies from classical to post-quantum cryptography
Emerging global standards
The adoption of post-quantum cryptographic primitives that balance security and performance
While large-scale quantum computers capable of breaking blockchain cryptography do not yet exist, Solana’s testnet deployment sends a clear message: preparation does not require waiting for the threat to arrive.
The Race to Future-Proof Blockchain Security Has Begun
Whether quantum computing becomes a real cryptographic threat in two years or ten, the direction of travel is clear. Blockchains are beginning to treat quantum resistance as a strategic infrastructure challenge, not a speculative risk.
By moving early, Solana has positioned itself among the first major networks to test quantum-resistant technology in a live blockchain environment. The outcome may shape how other ecosystems approach security upgrades in the years ahead.
The quantum era may not be here yet — but the race to prepare for it is clearly underway.
If you value in-depth, forward-looking analysis on blockchain technology and crypto security, make sure to follow for more insights and updates.

这两天粉丝全是问 BEAT 后续走势的，不少人盯着 4 小时图里那根缓涨的线，既想进场又怕被套，心态挺矛盾。
咱们直接点现在这行情，就是多头硬撑的虚架子

先看 MACD：黄白线还在 0 轴上方，但已经形成死叉。这不是空头砸盘的那种急跌信号，而是多头自己没了后劲，本来是上涨行情，结果内部接不上力，等于自己人先松了劲，属于温水煮青蛙式的走弱。
再看量能：价格往上磨，但成交量要么缩着要么没动静，这就是典型的 量价背离，没人真掏钱追涨，这价格就是少数资金撑着，根本站不住。
关键价位也很明确：上方 3.45 是强压力位，2.82 是近期第一个坎；下方 1.9 是短期支撑线，1.24 就是底线。现在这个位置，往上走每一步都是阻力。

我的判断很明确：现在冲高就是离场机会，回调是必然的。
今天想直接冲到 2.82 甚至摸 3.45？概率几乎没有。没量能支撑的死叉上涨，本质就是诱多，让散户觉得趋势还在，进来接盘而已。
更大的可能是：价格在当前位置稍微冲高一点，马上掉头往下，先测试 1.9 的支撑。要是 1.9 守不住，市场情绪一慌，奔着 1.24 去也不意外。

给玩家的操作建议：
已经持仓且仓位重的，等价格接近 2.82 时减一部分，别贪；
还没进场的，别追涨，等回调。要是跌到 1.9 附近稳住了，可以小仓位试试，但记住：分批买，仓位轻。
不管怎么做，止损必须带好，别等跌破关键位了再后悔。

translatedData.content:
Why does Japan's interest rate hike cause turmoil in the cryptocurrency market as if a small-scale black swan event has occurred? Let's discuss the reasons behind this.

First, let's talk about how Japan's interest rate hike affects the cryptocurrency market. For the past one or two decades, the Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank have been raising and lowering interest rates as if it were a game, but Japan has long maintained a zero or even negative interest rate, which has become a 'treasury' for the global financial system, providing endless liquidity. The cryptocurrency market relies on this extra liquidity to 'survive.' Only when traditional financial markets, like the US stock market and bond market, have so much money that there's nowhere to invest it will funds flow into the highest-risk cryptocurrency market.

For example, if the Bank of Japan is a bank that offers you loans at almost zero interest, you can borrow a large sum of yen at a very low cost. You can then take this money to low-risk investment markets in the US to arbitrage, such as buying US bonds or trading US stocks, and of course, you can also enter the cryptocurrency market. With this nearly interest-free yen, you can profit from the price difference; it's like pulling a fast one, essentially borrowing yen that doesn't incur interest to buy high-interest assets.

So why is Japan's interest rate hike considered a black swan? Risk-free arbitrage has two conditions: one is that the yen interest rate must remain low, and the other is that the yen exchange rate cannot fluctuate too much; otherwise, when it's time to repay, the exchange rate difference could result in losses. But now the Bank of Japan has announced an interest rate hike, which means the cost of borrowing money has increased, and the arbitrage cost has suddenly gone up. Moreover, the yen exchange rate will likely skyrocket; according to market rules, an interest rate hike will make the yen more valuable, and when it's time to repay, the exchange rate difference between the dollar and yen will add significant expenses.

Why does the cryptocurrency market crash and experience black swan events?

Whether it's institutions or arbitrage hedge funds, when they find that the cost of borrowed money has increased, arbitrage profits can even start to incur losses given the skyrocketing yen exchange rate. This leads to arbitrage funds beginning to flee, exchanging Bitcoin for dollars, then for yen, flowing out of the cryptocurrency market and other financial markets back into cash.

In simple terms, it's like the creditor is coming to collect debts, and everyone can only sell Bitcoin to repay their debts.

As for the next investment direction, I will guide everyone to focus on the highly profitable opportunities in altcoins. Those who want to get on board can gather in the chat room #美国非农数据超预期 #ETH .

content:
为啥日本一加息，币圈就像遭了小规模黑天鹅似的动荡？咱来唠唠这背后的原因

先说说日本加息咋就对币圈有影响。过去一二十年，美联储和欧洲央行加息降息跟玩似的，可日本呢，长期搞零利率甚至负利率，这就好比成了全球金融系统的“大金库”，有取之不尽的流动性。而币圈呢，就是靠这些多出来的流动性“吃饭”的。只有传统金融市场，像美股、债市这些地方钱多到没地方花的时候，资金才会跑到风险最高的币圈来

打个比方，假设日本央行是个银行，它给你提供利率几乎为零的贷款，你就能用极低的成本贷到一大笔日元。然后你拿着这笔钱，去美国那些低风险的理财市场套利，最简单的就是买美债、炒美股，当然也能进币圈。靠着这笔几乎没利息的日元，就能赚取差价，这简直就是空手套白狼，本质就是借不用付利息的日元买高利息的资产

那为啥说日本加息就是黑天鹅呢？无风险套利得满足俩条件，一是日元利息得一直低，二是日元汇率不能有太大波动，不然还钱的时候汇率差会让你亏钱。可现在日本央行说要加息了，这就意味着你借钱的利息变贵了，套利成本一下子就上去了。而且日元汇率还会暴涨，按照市场规律，加息会让日元更值钱，你还钱的时候，美元和日元的汇率差又是一笔不小的开支。

为啥币圈会崩盘，出现黑天鹅事件呢

不管是机构还是套利对冲基金，发现手里借来的钱成本变高了，套利利润在日元汇率暴涨的情况下，甚至都开始亏损了。这就导致套利资金开始往外跑，从比特币换成美元，再换成日元，从币圈等各个金融市场流出去，变回现金

简单来说，就是债主来要债了，大家只能卖比特币来还钱。

title: 认命了，考完试尽快把原型机弄出来申专利赚授权费，我没有在这里赚钱的本事。是什么人做什么事。
subTitle:
最近半年感觉没有做出一些太有意义的事:三分之一时间做题，三分之一时间研究新专利，三分之一时间专门玩这个软件。
结果现在发现只有第二个搞出了名堂，我预计考完试之后一个月不到能把原型机造出来（主要是一些东西要用3d打印机来搞，要从头学这些知识）再加上之前赚的一点钱，专利申请费应该是够的，就创新性和实用性而言，再就未来的世界右起混乱度加剧的局势，这必然是一个民间很好的防护类商品，根本不愁卖。要是能拿到地方的补贴金就提前能回款了，出去看看也方便。
第三个也就是这个APP我明白了自己根本赚不到大钱。搞基础的玩法资金量根本不够玩不起来。第一次玩杠杆，不知道默认的全仓，一不小心就赔完了，最后改了改，也只能玩玩较低倍的，被反复拉爆了几次，彻底放弃搞统计测算算均值设定大概点位了，玩不过市场的 。
你说要稳一点，那也只能找一些大币种在平均线的高位或者低位去开个低杠杆的多或者多，然后赚点小钱，这也就够平时一个早饭钱赚的也太慢了，要把本金滚起来不知道要多久。
 这个东西不仅要算纵向的跳动，还有时间的变动。你哪怕预估个一两步的可能线段变化，它也有可能随时拉爆。又因为它是锁仓的。一旦在一段时间内确定了大差距的走势，确定不能回归，你连止损的资格都没有。只能看着他锁在里面被删除。都这么久了，也应该认清自己的水平。我手里余下的钱也是真的不能动了，那是要留下来交申请费的。
我研究这个一开始是因为我那个广东朋友强到能靠这个稳定吃饭，他玩了两年多之后就稳定下来了，现在一个月赚个万把刀非常容易。但现在看来他那种内化的方法应该是无可复制，反正我现在感觉学不过来了，我彻底放弃了。最近几周联系不到了，他的全平台账号全部注销了，大概率是出去了。我后来用笔算了算，再用AI辅助算了算这个最近两周的纵轴线变化波度和时间算了算，这玩意儿嗯，怎么说呢？我不否认，也许有极个别的神仙人他可以通过坚持训练达到高胜率，但我不觉得普通人可以持续靠他稳定盈利。
最好的是把它当做彩票游戏，有闲散资金，心情好，拿它玩一玩，赢了，买个好心情输了，也可以平静一下。
#LUNC 不是说团队都都坐牢了吗？怎么还动不动有人拉？我平时就隔几个小时看一下均线在算好的地方。放下一个开空就放着就不管了，要不是因为因为安全需求经常放两倍的保证金就被拉爆了。我是在社区看到那些人说什么专门盯垃圾币在什么高位做空就行了，我就只搞低倍的，空也是真能赚到，但不多就是了。

#ETH 我觉得他的体量会低一点吧，就倍数开高一点也给爆了，就挂在旁边就做做题或者画画设计图，结果一抬头，已经爆了。如果只是开三倍，五倍的走算好的点位开多开空，那再怎么说，哪怕扛一会也是有赚头的，但太慢了，一天的收入算一算，还没有私下接点散活赚的多。我本金低。很容易说保守的开点位，结果挂不上。稍微激进点的挂，结果就被套住了，很长一段时间不能把钱拿出来。虽然说套住之后，因为它的周期性解套容易，因为倍数低也不怕，但是资金费还有时间成本就高了。

我打算考完试后第一个周一就去把护照先办下来，因为东西我肯定准备多卖几家，必然要出去的。实用新型专利出加急费的话很快就能到手，正常的发明专利，当然也要申请。但第一个到手就已经可以去谈合作了，我让自家律师帮我到本省找找人，找找渠道，就我了解到的人脉关系而言应该是卖的出去的，这玩意儿控制依托机械和简单的电子元件响应速度快成本也老便宜了，同行业的那些厂家肯定愿意花钱买这种专利，回去搞挂装改造的，改一改装一装就能当升级版卖了。
行业老大开的价低就卖给老二，总会有人要的，年中如果所里有闲的律师的话，我找个陪我去本子或者韩国看看能不能找更好的卖家。我现在是彻底不想上班了，这不纯纯浪费生命?
平常做做题啊，学学就会想想别的，就会想社会构成，想想经济情况再想想……
反正可以确定一点，劳动，尤其正常劳动对不对，肯定是不能发财的。在资本主义社会，你要发财，那肯定要搞资本倾向的经营。那搞什么呢？
我其实个人是很理解一些长辈还有一些亲人的建议的，他们就是希望孩子们正常读个书，找个好工作，安稳上上班。但毕竟现在不是七八十年代了，你考上了工作，就业也就那样。钱赚不了多少，位置也爬不了多高。我估计就业的话，原来说早些年这个专业读个研出来就业。20万很随便，现在估计15万12万都难拿了，资本复利要发财，怎么搞？我估计本职工作干个15年也赚不到1000万，我这么说，肯定是因为放在一几年，搞个15年肯定赚得到（当然不是在这个行业里死命干，不动脑子，就像律师不可能只赚打官司的钱，会计也不会只赚算账的钱。这个行业里的人要是能搞个IPO赚的可比常规行业不知道高多少，当然现在已经很萎靡了，如果某股市里再次涌入天量的韭菜，应该能让他再次繁荣☺️）但你要是看了一些人的生活，你肯定会羡慕。我反正是觉得老老实实上班没有未来的。
我就看看社会新闻，世界经济各地区的变动发展（当然穷了吧唧的地区略过），尤其是一些国家和地区的多民族和宗教等问题之类的东西。我用AI做总结，算了算可能的需求。找到了可能的几个渠道，太暴利的没有资格摸，差一点的还是可以用用的。矛盾，前者摸都不能摸，但后者我觉得完全没问题。
我觉得未来的话，世界的混乱局势会加剧，无论是哪个国家个人的安全问题一定是一个大市场。我设计了一套全新的被动瞬时激发防护装备（主动模式会更新挂载，然后常规刀剑一定程度上可以无视，还能即时反向制动，但是自爆人肯定还是扛不住的😜不过就算是这样，那些地区应该也能照样卖。后续进阶的研究，我无论是材料还是资源技术根本跟不上，而且地区法律所限，就算是前置的一些研究都根本不能搞，只能先放一边，脑子里的构想我只能等以后再说，先把0~1解决）目前材料之类的全部都搞定了，打印机还也ok，但还得我继续学学3d打印方面的玩意儿，一些需要特定设计的模块必须人为地改出来，之后剩下的就是玩乐高了。原型机出来之后，进一步就是材料和外形优化，这就是纯折腾时间的问题。已经可以一边谈合作一边搞优化了，早一点谈妥投产早一点能拿钱。
生活不易，我以前很羡慕一些同学或者朋友，生活极其富裕（有的润了，还有的家里盖期房卷款子被抓了，但不可以否定人家的那些生活是真他妈爽，谁不想隔几天左右两边就能换换人大手大脚的花钱）可要得到资本要么投胎，要么技术换，要么靠劳动搞到第一桶金。我靠技术把两个预设的专利弄出来，让家里帮忙应该是能帮我找到一个好下家的，现在这半年我也明白了自己真正喜欢什么，追求什么，我喜欢自由的生活，闲散的生活，最好是能同时把爱好变成饭的生活，特别是一些知识和研究更开放的环境。
尤其是研究制动防护模式的一些激发模块。国内不能用火药，气动受限制。（我查过有一些地区是允许一定限度内进行分级研究的，我准备去那些地区拿到许可后进行优化）目前只能用别的机械和电子原件改一改模拟效果，这样一来的话，相应的激发防护效果是同样有的，只是弱一点。但怎么都比人类的反应速度高，照样顶用，只是是用第三种模式进行修改的话，成本会上来就不是每一个人都买得起了。
至今有一个半月没有做过题了，虽然单科起码都做过两套，现在再做几张卷子，很快能捡回手感。但说实话，现在手挺生了，而且有了很深的厌恶感，除了拿笔画图和拿零件玩拼多多的时候有点激情，已经不想拿它写其他东西了。我现在想明白了自己需要什么东西，究竟想做什么，但更多的人呢？
曾经假期兼职的时候也去干过一些工作，当然不是家里介绍的，是自己找的。我都很震惊，这些工作是为什么有的人能日复一日，年复一年的干？这不压抑吗？不难受吗？我曾经干了一个月的保安，搞的人都难受的想上吊了 :
生活完全没有未来。当时我除了当保安，还要每天给门口扫地，有事要换换饮水机的水，这都可以接受。最大的问题就是没有人接待的时候，你可以玩手机，打游戏，但是你不能做题目，背单词。特别有时候转到夜班的时候凌晨一两点没有人时候干干自己的事情，结果第二天经理会通过监控说你晚上的时候搞学习会影响公司的安全，没有尽到责任的义务，再之后第二个月月初，不知道为什么被开了，然后后来换了个人进来。于是才知道这种工作居然都要关系，这会社会一个月几千块钱的坐岗保安居然都要用抢的？工作不至于这么难找吧？
现在在常规的基础行业工作的，他们如果有家庭有孩子的话，积蓄普遍都不会特别多，如是，今年大规模的返乡人群中应该不会过一个好年，可年关中一些钱又不能节省，买节礼，送红包，钱一花完之后兜里肯定会变薄，很多人或者家庭会因为钱吵架，然后有些事情可以预想的。家庭的矛盾多了很容易扩大，大量的人群像摊煎饼一样大大的摊开，但地方的就业岗位就那么多，经济缺口反而会扩大，维稳成本也会上升。
大学之前我并不搞什么工作，就算兼职也是在节假日里玩闹似的做做。
我的家庭教育还算挺好的，同辈兄弟们很多都会故意在假期被安排去干一些体力活，大家都干过类似的一些工作。我干过工地，干过保安，去家具厂里当过加工员，还去某三星级酒店里干过一个半月的传菜员和洗菜工。当然都只是暑假干一干，工资倒是其次，反正赚多赚少，老人们都会给你补。主要是怎么说呢？一是磨磨心性，二是保持同理心，后者是家里反复强调的，自以为的膨胀很容易就变得不是东西了。
尤其是对一些人彻底的不尊重，因为我是见过的嘛，一些人对跟你同辈同圈人会表示起码的尊重，但往下面的那真的是……那个态度说不尊重都算是保守了，那根本是不把人当人。
大家都过得挺苦的，以前假期点外卖的时候，如果当天有点余钱或者说有额外的红包，我都点两份的。或者给上门的外卖小哥多一杯蜜雪或者汉堡。但感觉还是于事无补。难说未来会如何。
前几个月老是做着做着就陷入了迷茫，考起之后能如何?继续玩三年吗？三年后出来呢？我自信有人帮忙的话，不会担心没有工作。肯定能在这个专业里找到一个略高于平均线收入和平均前程水平的工作，但一想想未来的十几年就感觉很无聊，我估计就这个经济面未来这个行业也不会太好，我也许会因为某些优势很长一段时间不被裁，但也别想赚太多钱了，没有红利的行业，也就是正常的混个温饱，没什么太光鲜的未来。
我觉得未来的经济通缩还有一些问题并不会变好，只会加剧。一些基础的经济知识简单算一算，整合一下就能明白是个什么情况？并不是很难懂的东西。我认为这种情况下，追求个人的自由和资本复利才是最实在的。
晚饭的时候我看到软件后台还有这种创作者栏目，原来粉丝量高了，别人从你链接里点什么东西，你还能得到手续费分成吗。我准备就把这个当生活号了。
我把原型机商品化改造后会往这里放放照片，到时候简单识图一下，应该就知道是哪里的。而且这个社区我觉得比其他社区普遍要热情的多，起码普遍都能好好说话，不会张口闭口开始问候族谱，而且一些简单的问题大家都乐于回复。更重要的是大家多多少少都赔过钱，知道要具体问题具体分析，具体思考，不会那么轴。
明明是零和博弈的平台，但大家不会有什么大矛盾。反正，挺热闹的，大家都挺有意思，少有的和谐社区了。

Plus, with the little money I earned before, the patent application fee should be enough. In terms of innovation and practicality, given the future situation where chaos is intensifying, this will definitely be a very good protective product for the public, and there will be no worries about selling it. If I can get local subsidies, I can recoup the costs in advance, which will also make it easier to go out and explore.

title: El Petróleo Cae, el Dólar Digital Sube: El Ascenso Definitivo de USDT como "Commodity" en Venezuela
subTitle:
#USDT

{spot}(BTCUSDT)

{future}(ETHUSDT)
La historia económica recordará diciembre de 2025 como el mes en que el petróleo dejó de ser el único termómetro de la economía venezolana. Mientras el precio del crudo Brent se tambalea cerca de los $60 —presionado por un superávit global y el bloqueo total a tanqueros sancionados impuesto por la administración Trump—, un fenómeno financiero está ocurriendo en las sombras: el drenaje masivo de capital hacia el criptomercado.
En este escenario de asfixia financiera, un activo se ha consolidado no solo como refugio, sino como el nuevo estándar de intercambio: Tether (USDT).
1. El Desacoplamiento Energético
Históricamente, una caída en los ingresos petroleros venezolanos arrastraba consigo toda la liquidez del país. Sin embargo, en 2025, el endurecimiento de las sanciones ha forzado un desacoplamiento. Ante la imposibilidad de mover dólares físicos o realizar transferencias vía SWIFT, los actores económicos (desde el sector industrial hasta el ciudadano de a pie) han "drenado" su valor hacia el mercado cripto.
 * Impacto en Precios: Mientras el petróleo ha perdido un 15% de su valor en el último trimestre, el volumen de transacciones en criptoactivos en la región ha crecido un 22%.
 * El flujo de capital: El dinero que antes se quedaba en cuentas bancarias internacionales o en contratos de crudo a futuro, ahora fluye hacia billeteras digitales buscando evadir el cerco naval y financiero.
2. USDT: El Ganador por Consolidación
Si bien Bitcoin (BTC) ha servido como reserva de valor frente a la devaluación del bolívar (que ya supera el 300% anual), es el USDT el que se ha coronado como la moneda del sistema.
 * Uso como "Petrodólar Digital": Reportes de diciembre confirman que PDVSA y sus socios comerciales están liquidando hasta el 80% de sus ventas de crudo residual en USDT. Esto garantiza que la liquidez entre al país sin pasar por bancos corresponsales estadounidenses.
 * Estabilidad en el Caos: En un mes donde el petróleo es volátil y los activos de riesgo como Ethereum (ETH) sufren correcciones, el USDT ofrece la paridad 1:1 necesaria para el comercio diario y el pago de suministros.
3. Tendencia: ¿Por qué se mantendrá?
A diferencia de otros ciclos alcistas impulsados por la especulación, la actual consolidación de los criptoactivos en este escenario es por necesidad estructural.
 * Resiliencia a la Incautación: Mientras EE. UU. ha logrado incautar físicamente petroleros (como el caso del buque Skipper este mes), bloquear flujos en USDT requiere una cooperación técnica de Tether Ltd. que, aunque posible, es mucho más lenta y compleja que un bloqueo naval.
 * Adopción Masiva: Venezuela ha escalado al puesto 11 del Índice Global de Adopción de TRM Labs. Esta base de usuarios no abandonará el ecosistema una vez que la crisis pase; el hábito de la economía digital ya está arraigado.
Conclusión
El escenario de diciembre de 2025 marca el fin del petróleo como único motor financiero regional. El "drenaje" de inversores hacia las criptos no es una moda pasajera, es una respuesta defensiva. En este tablero, mientras el crudo flaquea, el USDT se proyecta como el activo con mayor tendencia a mantenerse, actuando como el lubricante esencial de una economía que ha aprendido a operar fuera del sistema.

#PTBUSDT 32 years to achieve financial freedom, what I rely on is trading cryptocurrencies, but what truly changed my destiny are these 6 words. I started to get in touch with cryptocurrency at 22, with no background, no resources, relying on a laptop and a mobile phone. By 2025, I grew my account to eight digits. But I want to tell you: technology is not the key, mindset is the decisive factor.
People doing e-commerce and traditional industries may envy us cryptocurrency traders for having no inventory and no disputes.
But only those who have experienced it know that this market is a psychological game.
#zec 10 years of experience, I have summarized 6 survival rules.
1. Position risk control: 3% stop-loss bottom line
I set rules for myself: a single stop-loss should not exceed 3% of the account! For example, with a $5000 account, try to keep a single loss within $150. Previously, heavily invested 1.2 lots chasing the rise, exploded in 10 minutes losing $3000, only after suffering losses did I understand that light positions can withstand fluctuations!
2. Avoid four types of sensitive trading periods (personal experience, proceed with caution)
Tokyo opening (6:00-8:00): many market spikes, easy to fake breakouts
#ETH  European morning (14:00-15:00): severe fluctuations, hard to grasp
US data period (20:15-21:00): such as non-farm night, market changes quickly
After 1 AM: liquidity is exhausted, fluctuations are hard to capture.
Chasing shorts on non-farm night, lost 50 points in 2 minutes! Now try to avoid these extreme periods.
3. Trend judgment: moving averages + RSI double confirmation
I am accustomed to using the daily 200 moving average to see the big direction, combined with the 1-hour RSI oversold (<30) + engulfing pattern to find entry points. #BTC
4. Small method for moving stop profits:
Profit 15 points: set a break-even stop-loss, first protect the capital
Profit 30 points: move stop-loss up 10 points, lock in partial profits
Profit 50 points: adjust stop-loss based on previous lows, let profits run
5. Emotion management: stop trading when the state is not right
After staying up late, after arguments, after consecutive losses, the win rate plummets! Previously, when in a bad mood, the win rate was 38%, and I stubbornly increased my position, losing 20% of the account. Here is a simple cryptocurrency trading method, as long as you persist, achieving stable profits is not difficult. At most, choose 2 - 3 coins; trading too many coins makes it difficult to make reasonable judgments during market fluctuations, leading to mistakes.

2. Handle ups and downs calmly: When the market surges, do not impulsively chase buying fantasy wealth; during sharp declines, do not panic and sell out of fear of losing all your capital. Emotional fluctuations can easily cause you to miss the right trading opportunities; always remain calm.

title: ASTER Giảm 50%: Cơ hội cho người kiên nhẫn hay cái bẫy của hy vọng ?
subTitle:
Trong vòng khoảng một tháng trở lại đây, Aster đã trải qua một cú điều chỉnh mạnh khi giá giảm gần 50%, từ vùng trên 1,4–1,5 USD về quanh 0,74 USD.
Sau cú giảm này, phần lớn nhà đầu tư ngắn hạn đã bị loại khỏi thị trường. Những người mua đuổi ở vùng 1,2–1,5 USD rơi vào trạng thái kẹt hàng, tâm lý sợ hãi chi phối và chỉ chờ những nhịp hồi yếu để thoát.
Đây chính là lý do vì sao, ngay cả khi giá có nhịp hồi, lực bán vẫn xuất hiện rất nhanh. Với trader, điều này cho thấy ASTER chưa thể bước ngay vào một xu hướng tăng bền vững, mà nhiều khả năng vẫn cần thời gian tích lũy và hấp thụ cung.
Về mặt hành vi giá, vùng quanh 0,72–0,75 USD đang đóng vai trò như một vùng cân bằng tạm thời. Đây là khu vực mà lực bán đã giảm dần so với giai đoạn hoảng loạn trước đó, nhưng lực mua cũng chưa đủ mạnh để đẩy giá đi xa.
Nếu giá giữ vững được vùng này và khối lượng bán tiếp tục suy yếu, đó sẽ là tín hiệu cho thấy phe bán đang dần cạn lực. Ngược lại, nếu mốc 0,72 USD bị xuyên thủng một cách dứt khoát, khả năng cao ASTER sẽ còn phải tìm điểm cân bằng thấp hơn, khi những người còn hy vọng bắt đầu buông bỏ.
Ở kịch bản tích cực, nếu thị trường chung ổn định hơn và ASTER có thể hồi phục lên lại vùng 0,85–0,95 USD, trader cần đặc biệt cảnh giác. Đây không phải vùng để FOMO, mà là vùng rất dễ xuất hiện nhịp hồi kỹ thuật kèm theo áp lực xả hàng từ những người kẹt ở phía trên.
Chỉ khi nào ASTER vượt qua được vùng này với khối lượng tốt và giữ giá ổn định, lúc đó câu chuyện đảo chiều xu hướng mới thực sự đáng bàn.
Điểm mấu chốt mà trader cần nhớ là: đáy không phải là một cây nến, mà là cả một quá trình. ASTER có thể đã rơi sâu, nhưng điều đó không đồng nghĩa với việc nó đã sẵn sàng cho một con sóng mới ngay lập tức. Trong giai đoạn này, chiến lược phù hợp hơn là quan sát phản ứng giá, chia vốn nhỏ nếu tham gia, và tuyệt đối tránh tâm lý “bắt đáy all-in”.
Về tâm lý thị trường, ASTER hiện đang ở trạng thái rất đặc trưng: người nắm giữ thì mệt mỏi, người đứng ngoài thì nghi ngờ. Đây chính là môi trường mà dòng tiền lớn thường âm thầm hành động, nhưng cũng là nơi rất nhiều trader nhỏ lẻ tiếp tục mất kiên nhẫn. Vì vậy, thay vì hỏi “ASTER có tăng không”, câu hỏi đúng hơn là: nó cần bao lâu để thị trường quên đi cú giảm này?
Kết lại dưới góc nhìn trader: ASTER ở vùng giá hiện tại không còn là hàng nóng để mua đuổi, nhưng cũng chưa phải hàng bỏ đi. Nó phù hợp cho những người có kế hoạch rõ ràng, chấp nhận đi chậm và ưu tiên quản trị rủi ro, hơn là những ai tìm kiếm lợi nhuận nhanh trong vài phiên.

title: J.P. Morgan launches a $100M tokenized fund on Ethereum as ETH flows remain cautious.
subTitle:
J.P. Morgan has taken another decisive step into blockchain finance.
According to The Wall Street Journal, the world’s largest bank by market capitalization has announced the launch of its first-ever tokenized money market fund, MONY, built on the Ethereum blockchain.
The bank is seeding the fund with $100 million of its own capital. External investors are expected to gain access from the 16th of December.

The move signals growing confidence in Ethereum [ETH] as an institutional-grade financial infrastructure.
Institutional confidence meets cautious market flows
Even as J.P. Morgan’s move adds to the positivity surrounding Ethereum’s future, its short-term sentiment sparks mixed signals.
Despite the growing number of participants for both whales and institutions, the ETFs’ net flows for Ethereum remained in the red, as $224 million worth of ETH was withdrawn from the market.
This implies that some large institutional wallets are still net selling even as new financial products emerge on-chain. Indeed, this causes price optimism to seem moderated by risk management in the near term.
Ethereum exchange activity sparks mixed signals
On-chain exchange data added another layer to the indecisive ETFs inflow.
Ethereum inflows to exchanges have risen steadily over the last three days, often a sign of potential early accumulation phase.
However, over the last 24 hours, that inflow volume dropped sharply by $700K, settling at $382K.
All in all, the overall inflows trend remain positive. CryptoQuant’s Average Inflow data indicated a positive trajectory, with the average inflows surging from 35 ETH to 42 ETH over the same period.
Supply continues to surge
At the same time, Ethereum’s circulating supply has continued its upward trajectory. At press time, total supply stood at 121.44 million ETH, reflecting consistent issuance.
This expanding supply could limit the short-term bullish run unless demand accelerates alongside it.
Institutional launches like MONY paired with the recent whale activity surge, may help that demand build gradually rather than instantly.

title: Bitcoin, Ether, and XRP Slide as Crypto Market Retests $3 Trillion Support
subTitle:
Bitcoin, Ether, and XRP Slide as Crypto Market Retests $3 Trillion Support
The cryptocurrency market extended its late-year pullback, with total market capitalization slipping below $3 trillion once again marking the third test of this key psychological level in December. The repeated failure to hold above this threshold is intensifying downside pressure, particularly across large-cap assets.
Large-Cap Assets Lead the Decline
Bitcoin fell roughly 1.5% to around $86,580, erasing part of the prior session’s rebound. Ether eased back to $2,930 after briefly approaching $3,000, while XRP stalled near $1.90, failing to extend its recovery.
These assets—earlier leaders of institutional inflows—are now underperforming, signaling a broader reassessment of risk exposure as the year-end approaches.
Institutional Positioning Shifts
Market participants point to institutional rebalancing and profit-taking as a key driver of the move. Assets with the highest institutional exposure, including those linked to ETF flows, are showing heightened sensitivity to sentiment changes.
Unlike retail-driven selloffs, current price action reflects selective reductions in exposure rather than broad panic, suggesting a controlled but persistent de-risking process.
Sentiment Deteriorates Further
Market psychology has weakened sharply. The crypto fear and greed index has dropped to 11, its lowest level in weeks, firmly in fear territory. Such readings often coincide with extended consolidation or deeper corrective phases, particularly when accompanied by declining liquidity.
Technical Structure Under Pressure
From a technical perspective, Bitcoin’s failure to reclaim recent support zones exposes the market to a potential test of $81,000, a level aligned with prior consolidation. A sustained break lower could open the door toward the $60,000–$70,000 region, a historically significant area from earlier cycle transitions.
Year-end conditions are compounding volatility. Thin liquidity, muted leverage, and reduced trading volumes are allowing relatively modest flows to generate outsized price moves.
Divergence from Traditional Markets
Crypto’s weakness contrasts with modest gains in major Asian equity indices, supported by expectations of fiscal stimulus. The divergence highlights crypto’s increasing sensitivity to sector-specific flows rather than broader risk sentiment.
On-Chain Signals Offer a Mixed Picture
On-chain data suggests short-term exhaustion following earlier rallies, leaving room for additional downside. At the same time, long-term accumulation by corporations and financial entities continues, indicating underlying confidence at lower price levels.
What Comes Next
The market’s ability to stabilize above $3 trillion will be critical. A sustained break lower risks accelerating losses, while renewed institutional demand could cap downside and force consolidation.
For now, the balance of risks remains tilted toward caution as traders navigate reduced liquidity and shifting institutional sentiment making this support test a defining moment for the final stretch of the year.

#zec  I am not a rich second generation, not an insider, do not know mystical indicators, and have no "insider teacher".

Unwilling to be led by salary, mortgage, and life for a lifetime.

#ETH  Trading really feels like an exciting yet cruel romantic journey.

You think you are in love with the market,

But the next second you are awakened by a needle prick.

Liquidation, drawdown, doubting life,

The account shines green, and the mentality shatters completely.

But I slowly understand:

The market is not short of opportunities, but short of people who can survive.

From full-margin gamble to light-margin trial and error;

From chasing highs and selling lows to only doing certainty;

From trading every day to patiently waiting;

From bearing emotions alone to reviewing with a group of people, growing together.

Someone asked me:

"Is it important to make money?"

Important.

But what’s more important is —

What kind of person you have become in this process.

Later, the market gave the answer.

1000U → 10,000 → 100,000 → 500,000.

It's not getting rich overnight, but the confidence left after stepping into pits again and again.

It’s not a god operation, but ingraining risk control into the bones.

I have seen too many people:

Some harvest heavy debts,

Some harvest the stars and the sea.

The difference has never been luck, but choice.

If you are also on the road,

The account is still small, the direction is still unclear, emotions are still chaotic,

Don’t rush.

Those who can endure the darkest moments,

Deserve the next wave.

Stepping on the southern sky, shattering the spirit of the night.

This journey in the crypto world,

I have returned,

And I am willing to take you together,

To see a bigger world.

#PTBUSDT 一单止盈37万！！踏南天，碎灵宵，若一去不回，便一去不回。

有人把这句话写进热血小说，我把它走进了币圈。

还记得最开始，我只有 1000U。

#zec 不是富二代，不是消息通，不会玄学指标，更没有“内幕老师”。

有的，只是一点不甘心——

不甘心一辈子被工资、房贷、生活牵着走。

#ETH 交易真的很像一场刺激又残酷的浪漫之旅。

你以为自己在和行情谈恋爱，

结果下一秒就被一根针扎醒。

爆仓、回撤、怀疑人生，

账户绿得发光，心态碎得彻底。

但我慢慢明白：

市场不缺机会，缺的是能活下来的人。

从满仓梭哈，到轻仓试错；

从追涨杀跌，到只做确定性；

从天天交易，到耐心等待；

从一个人扛情绪，到带着一群人一起复盘、一起成长。

有人问我：

“赚没赚到钱重要吗？”

重要。

但更重要的是——

你在这个过程中，变成了什么样的人。

后来，行情给了答案。

1000U → 1万 → 10万 → 50万。

不是一夜暴富，是一次次踩坑后留下的底气。

不是神操作，是把风控刻进骨子里。

我见过太多人：

有人收获的是负债累累，

有人收获的是星辰大海。

差别从来不是运气，而是选择。

如果你也在路上，

账户还小、方向还迷、情绪还乱，

别急。

能熬过至暗时刻的人，

才配得上下一轮浪潮。

踏南天，碎灵宵。

这一趟币圈之旅，

我走回来了，

也愿意带你一起，

去看看更大的世界。

title: Bitcoin, Ether, and XRP Slide as Crypto Market Retests $3 Trillion Support
subTitle:
The cryptocurrency market extended its late-year pullback, with total market capitalization slipping below $3 trillion once again marking the third test of this key psychological level in December. The repeated failure to hold above this threshold is intensifying downside pressure, particularly across large-cap assets.
Large-Cap Assets Lead the Decline
Bitcoin fell roughly 1.5% to around $86,580, erasing part of the prior session’s rebound. Ether eased back to $2,930 after briefly approaching $3,000, while XRP stalled near $1.90, failing to extend its recovery.
These assets—earlier leaders of institutional inflows—are now underperforming, signaling a broader reassessment of risk exposure as the year-end approaches.
Institutional Positioning Shifts
Market participants point to institutional rebalancing and profit-taking as a key driver of the move. Assets with the highest institutional exposure, including those linked to ETF flows, are showing heightened sensitivity to sentiment changes.
Unlike retail-driven selloffs, current price action reflects selective reductions in exposure rather than broad panic, suggesting a controlled but persistent de-risking process.
Sentiment Deteriorates Further
Market psychology has weakened sharply. The crypto fear and greed index has dropped to 11, its lowest level in weeks, firmly in fear territory. Such readings often coincide with extended consolidation or deeper corrective phases, particularly when accompanied by declining liquidity.
Technical Structure Under Pressure
From a technical perspective, Bitcoin’s failure to reclaim recent support zones exposes the market to a potential test of $81,000, a level aligned with prior consolidation. A sustained break lower could open the door toward the $60,000–$70,000 region, a historically significant area from earlier cycle transitions.
Year-end conditions are compounding volatility. Thin liquidity, muted leverage, and reduced trading volumes are allowing relatively modest flows to generate outsized price moves.
Divergence from Traditional Markets
Crypto’s weakness contrasts with modest gains in major Asian equity indices, supported by expectations of fiscal stimulus. The divergence highlights crypto’s increasing sensitivity to sector-specific flows rather than broader risk sentiment.
On-Chain Signals Offer a Mixed Picture
On-chain data suggests short-term exhaustion following earlier rallies, leaving room for additional downside. At the same time, long-term accumulation by corporations and financial entities continues, indicating underlying confidence at lower price levels.
What Comes Next
The market’s ability to stabilize above $3 trillion will be critical. A sustained break lower risks accelerating losses, while renewed institutional demand could cap downside and force consolidation.
For now, the balance of risks remains tilted toward caution as traders navigate reduced liquidity and shifting institutional sentiment making this support test a defining moment for the final stretch of the year.

title: Whale Loses $20.4 Million on AI Agent Tokens in 88% Drawdown
subTitle:
A whale lost $20.4 million after investing $23 million in AI agent tokens on the Base blockchain, selling for just $2.58 million. This 88.77% drawdown stands as one of crypto’s largest single trade losses, with individual tokens dropping as much as 99%.
The extreme loss highlights rising fears of speculative bubbles in the AI token market. Here, hype and unclear use cases fuel extreme volatility across investment portfolios.
How a Whale Lost Over $20 Million on AI Agent Tokens
On-chain analytics platform Lookonchain tracked the whale’s portfolio across six AI agent tokens. The most significant loss was in FAI, which cost $9.87 million, a 92.31% drop. AIXBT resulted in a $7.81 million loss, representing an 83.74% decrease from the purchase price.
The remaining positions showed equally steep declines. BOTTO fell by $936,000, or 83.62%. POLY erased $839,000, plummeting 98.63%.
NFTXBT saw the steepest percentage drop, falling 99.13% and losing $594,000. MAICRO ended with a $381,000 loss, representing an 89.55% decline.
The investor’s wallet address now holds just $3,584 in assorted assets, mainly ETH and small holdings in BYTE, MONK, and SANTA. The dramatic exit highlights near-total losses from AI agent tokens.
AI Agent Token Speculation Under Scrutiny
The Base blockchain, from Coinbase, is a popular launchpad for AI crypto projects. However, the sector faces criticism for excessive hype and limited working products.
Many AI agent tokens lack real-world utility, leaving traders vulnerable to rapid gains and equally fast crashes.
Observers note that AI agent tokens often surge on promises rather than working use cases. Autonomous agents on the blockchain attract investor attention, but few projects deliver functional results.
As sentiment shifts, token holders face extreme risk due to thin liquidity and shallow utility.
“This might be one of the worst investments ever. A whale/institution spent $23M buying AI agent tokens on #Base and sold everything today for only $2.58M, resulting in a $20.43M(−88.77%) loss,” Lookonchain remarked.
The whale’s exit coincides with waning enthusiasm for AI tokens in early 2025, when the sector plunged 77%.
After a rush of AI-themed investments in late 2024, investors are reassessing as few projects meet their goals. This trend fuels further price drops, especially for tokens with concentrated ownership and little liquidity.
Risk Management: Lessons for Investors
The whale heavily concentrated funds in AI agent tokens on Base, lacking diversification and risk management.
Allocating $23 million across six correlated assets in one narrative increased systematic risk. As sentiment turned, all holdings fell, revealing the risk of concentrated positions.
Professional traders typically limit exposure to avoid outsized losses from failing narratives. The lack of stop-losses or disciplined sizing let the whale’s losses spiral.
By the time positions were closed, regaining even break-even status would have required extraordinary returns. The situation illustrates how fast declines occur without thorough analysis and risk planning.
With NFTXBT and POLY losing over 98%, a major comeback appears unlikely.
It remains uncertain whether this signals broader trouble for AI agent tokens. Projects with strong technical teams and real development may weather the storm.
Tokens using AI hype without solid backing are likely to keep struggling as the market asks for results and not just promises.

Welcome to the US Crypto News Morning Briefing—your essential rundown of the most important developments in crypto for the day ahead.
Grab a coffee as the latest US labor data delivers mixed signals on jobs, wages, and unemployment. Traders are weighing what it all means for risk assets, from equities to Bitcoin, as volatility sets the tone.
Crypto News of the Day: October Jobs Collapse and November Modest Gain Signal Uneven Market
The US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report for October and November 2025 delivered a shock to markets, as it is one of the crucial economic data points this week. It revealed a cooling labor market that could reverberate through both equities and crypto.
According to the US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS),October saw a sharp decline of 105,000 jobs, far below the estimated -25,000. This marks a pronounced slowdown in labor market momentum.
Analysts are labeling it an outlier, reflecting disruptions from delayed government data collection and seasonal adjustments.
November posted a 64,000 gain, slightly above the 50,000 consensus, but with the unemployment rate climbing to 4.6% from 4.4% in October, higher than the expected 4.5%.
While November’s rise offers some relief, it highlights the uneven nature of recent US labor market activity.
Fed and Market Implications For Bitcoin and Risk Assets
The data is likely to reinforce dovish narratives for the Federal Reserve. Powell previously cited a weakening labor market as justification for rate cuts, and today’s figures suggest the economy is far from overheated.
Traders may interpret the report as a signal that further easing in 2026 is plausible, which could support risk assets, including Bitcoin, if liquidity expectations remain intact. Bitcoin has been trapped near $90,000, and today’s data could trigger short-term volatility.
A weak October print followed by a modest November recovery may fuel a relief rally toward $95,000 as markets price in potential Fed accommodation.
Conversely, the unexpectedly high unemployment rate could reignite recession fears, creating whipsaw moves in crypto, equities, and FX.
“While markets typically cheer the resolution of uncertainty, this specific data dump is unique. The cooling trend might spark an initial crypto rally on renewed hopes for aggressive Fed cuts in 2026. But if the numbers are too weak, the narrative could quickly pivot from liquidity hopes to recession fears, historically dampening risk appetite across the board,” Jimmy Xue, COO and Co-founder at Axis, told BeInCrypto.
Market participants remain wary. With October’s data representing an outlier and November’s figures collected late, statistical distortions and revisions are possible.
Algorithm-driven trading and lean liquidity could amplify volatility in the near term, making measured positioning critical.
Amid mixed signals, traditional safe havens like gold may continue to attract flows, as the US dollar faces pressure and risk sentiment remains fragile in tech-heavy sectors.

title: Why Bitcoin Bear Markets Happen (Data-Driven)
subTitle:
Why Bitcoin Bear Markets Happen (Data-Driven)

Bitcoin bear markets happen for only two reasons:

1️⃣ Global liquidity turns negative (Fed tightening, strong dollar)
2️⃣ Forced selling from crypto-specific shocks (exchanges, miners, fraud)

Everything else is noise.

The Two Forces

🔹 Liquidity tightening
When rates rise and the dollar strengthens, leverage unwinds.
Bitcoin, the highest-beta asset, falls mechanically.

🔹 Forced selling
Crashes happen when sellers have no choice.
Exchange failures, fraud, or leverage overwhelm demand.

---

Every Major BTC Bear Market

• 2011: QE ends → dollar tightens
$32 → $2 (-93%)
➡️ Liquidity

• 2013–15: Mt. Gox collapse
$1,100 → $200 (-85%)
➡️ Forced selling

• 2017–18: Fed hikes + QT
$20k → $3k (-84%)
➡️ Liquidity

• Mar 2020: Dollar shortage
$9k → $3.8k (-60%)
➡️ Liquidity shock
(Printer on = bottom)

• 2021–22: Fastest hikes + Terra → FTX
$69k → $15.5k (-77%)
➡️ Both

---

What Isn’t a Bear Market

❌ 2019 pullback
❌ China mining ban
❌ 2023–25 drawdowns

No tightening. No forced sellers.

---

The Rule

No post-2013 Bitcoin bear market without:

• Negative global liquidity or
• Forced liquidation overwhelming demand

No exceptions.

---

Final Take

Bitcoin doesn’t crash because of fear or headlines.
It crashes when liquidity disappears or selling is forced.

Track liquidity — not narratives.

• Even strong coins can drop suddenly if the market structure gets shaken by mass liquidations.

𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐓𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐬
• Liquidation-driven moves are mechanical, not fundamental.
• Panic selling and forced exits often amplify volatility, even if news or fundamentals haven’t changed.
• Traders who react emotionally often lose capital, while disciplined ones can take advantage of opportunities.

𝐒𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐫 𝐀𝐩𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐚𝐜𝐡
• Avoid over-leveraged positions during high volatility.
• Keep stop-losses reasonable and position sizes small.
• Focus on support and resistance zones instead of chasing pumps or dumps.
• Sometimes, the best move is no trade at all.

The crypto market doesn’t punish price action it punishes poor risk management. Understanding liquidations and how they affect price is crucial to survive and thrive in volatile markets.
