title: Ethereum supply on exchanges drops to old lows as big players keep buying
subTitle:
Ethereum is entering a rare phase. The amount of ETH sitting on exchanges has fallen to levels last seen in twenty sixteen. This means far fewer coins are ready to sell at any moment. At the same time large companies and institutions are adding more ETH quietly and steadily.

New data shows the exchange supply ratio is now very low. This tells us most Ethereum is no longer held for quick trades. Instead it is being stored for longer use. In past cycles similar moments came before strong price moves. When supply dries up even small demand can move price fast.

What makes this phase different is who is buying. It is not only retail users. Public companies and large groups are now holding Ethereum in their treasuries. The number of these holders keeps growing. Together they now control millions of ETH. The value of these holdings has risen sharply over recent months.

One firm in particular added a very large amount of ETH in just thirty days. This was one of the fastest accumulation runs ever seen from a public entity. Moves like this were rare in earlier cycles. This adds a new layer of demand that did not exist before.

There are several reasons why Ethereum supply is tightening. A big share of ETH is locked in staking. These coins help secure the network and cannot be sold easily. Another large share sits inside layer two networks. These systems use ETH for fees and activity which pulls liquidity away from exchanges.

More companies now treat ETH as a working asset. They use it for apps payments and on chain systems. This changes how ETH is held. Instead of trading it they keep it ready for use. Long term holders are also choosing self custody more often. They move coins off exchanges and hold them directly.

All of this reduces sell pressure. When fewer coins are available to sell prices tend to react faster to demand. This does not guarantee a price jump tomorrow. But it changes the structure of the market.

Ethereum price has been unstable in recent weeks. It traded near twenty nine hundred and struggled to find direction. Short term moves still depend on the wider market. But under the surface the setup is shifting.

If this trend continues Ethereum could face a supply shock. That happens when demand stays steady or rises while supply stays tight. In those moments price can move faster than expected.

This cycle looks different from the past. Before retail demand led the way. Now long term demand from institutions plays a bigger role. These buyers tend to move slowly and quietly. They do not chase fast pumps. They build positions over time.

That patience can support price during weak periods. It can also limit deep drops since fewer coins sit ready to sell.

Ethereum today feels calm on the surface. But the supply picture tells another story. Coins are leaving exchanges. Big holders are adding. Liquidity is shrinking.

This does not promise instant gains. It does suggest strong long term support. Ethereum may be setting the stage for a powerful move when demand returns.

title: 【ETH】以太坊正在经历第三次爆发期，还会不会涨？通知已就位
subTitle:
以太坊历史上至少经历过 3 次“使用率跃迁期”，每一次，价格和地位都被抬上一个台阶。
第一次：
2017–2018｜从“没人用”到“ICO 全民链”
爆发前（≈1% 使用率）
以太坊只是技术宅在玩
普通人完全不知道“智能合约是啥”
爆发触发点
ICO 热潮
发币、募资、转账全在 ETH 上
结果
日交易数暴涨
Gas 经常堵到怀疑人生
ETH 从 $10 → $1,400
👉 这是第一次“10% 使用率冲击”：
币圈的人，第一次大规模真的在用它。
第二次：
2020–2021｜DeFi Summer：从“能用”到“离不开”
爆发前
ETH 主要还是转账链
用途单一
爆发触发点
Uniswap、Aave、Compound
普通人开始：
借钱
做市
挖矿
套利
发生了什么
TVL 从几十亿 → 几千亿
链上开始“真赚钱”
ETH 成为 金融系统本身
价格反馈
$88 → $4,878
👉 这是第二次：
“有用” → “没它不行”
第三次（正在发生）：
2024–2026｜Layer 2 + RWA：从“币圈工具”到“真实世界用”
这一轮很多人没意识到。
爆发前
ETH = 炒币用
普通用户嫌贵、嫌慢
现在正在发生什么
Base / Arbitrum 用户暴涨
USDC、国债、基金开始上链
大机构用 L2，但结算还在 ETH
你可以把它理解为：
ETH 正在从“10% 的币圈人在用”，
走向“10% 的金融世界在用”。
这一步如果走成，级别比前两次都高。

ETH 每一次真正的大行情，
都不是“价格先涨”，
而是“使用率先破圈”。
价格只是 “使用率上一个台阶后的结果”。
那现在算不算“10% 爆发前夜”？
说实话：
如果你拿 “全球金融/资产结算”当总盘子
那 ETH 的渗透率 连 5% 都没到
也正因为如此：
它涨得慢
它不刺激
它不讲神话
但也因此：
它还没走完它最值钱的那一段。

以太坊历史上每一次真正的牛市，
都不是因为“讲得更好听”，
而是因为 使用率从 1% 跨过了 10% 的临界点。
而今天，Layer 2 + RWA，
正在把 ETH 推向 下一次真实使用破圈。

Ethereum has pushed back toward the 3,000 zone after defending the 2,880–2,900 support area. This move is coming alongside BTC strength, but ETH is still trading inside a broader corrective structure on the higher timeframe. This makes level-based execution very important here.

Momentum is improving, but ETH has not yet reclaimed its higher timeframe trend.

Big Picture View Despite the bounce, ETH is still below major daily resistance. This move looks more like a relief push following support defense rather than a confirmed bullish continuation. Until ETH cleanly reclaims and holds above 3,100, both longs and shorts should be treated as tactical trades, not swing positions.

Trade levels, manage risk, and stay flexible. Markets change fast — your bias should too.

title: Ethereum (ETH): The Core Infrastructure of the Digital Economy
subTitle:
Ethereum is no longer just a cryptocurrency; it has evolved into the foundational infrastructure layer of the modern blockchain ecosystem. While market participants often focus on short-term price action, Ethereum’s true value lies in its role as the settlement layer for decentralized finance, digital assets, and emerging real-world blockchain applications.
Since its launch, Ethereum has consistently been the platform where meaningful innovation happens first. Decentralized exchanges, lending protocols, stablecoins, NFTs, DAOs, Layer-2 networks, and now real-world asset tokenization all trace their origins back to Ethereum. This network effect is not accidental it is the result of years of developer trust, tooling maturity, and battle-tested security.
One of Ethereum’s strongest advantages is its developer ecosystem. Thousands of developers build on Ethereum daily, supported by robust frameworks, documentation, and an open innovation culture. This continuous development ensures that Ethereum remains adaptable, capable of upgrading its architecture without sacrificing decentralization. Few networks can claim this level of technical resilience while operating at global scale.
The transition to Proof-of-Stake marked a defining moment in Ethereum’s history. Beyond reducing energy consumption, it fundamentally changed ETH’s economic model. With staking locking up supply and EIP-1559 introducing fee burning, Ethereum now operates under a deflationary or near-neutral issuance model during periods of high network activity. This directly links network usage to ETH’s long-term value proposition, aligning incentives between users, developers, and holders.
Scalability, once Ethereum’s most criticized limitation, is being addressed through a modular design approach. Rather than forcing everything onto the base layer, Ethereum leverages Layer-2 rollups to handle high transaction throughput while maintaining security on the main chain. This strategy allows Ethereum to scale without compromising decentralization  a trade-off many faster chains struggle to balance.

From an institutional perspective, Ethereum is increasingly viewed as programmable financial infrastructure rather than a speculative asset. Tokenized bonds, on-chain funds, stablecoin settlement, and compliance-aware DeFi applications are already being built on Ethereum and its Layer-2s. As traditional finance experiments with blockchain integration, Ethereum remains the default choice due to its security guarantees and global liquidity.
Another often overlooked strength is Ethereum’s credibility during market stress. Through multiple bear markets, regulatory pressure, and technological shifts, Ethereum has not only survived but strengthened its position. This resilience builds long-term confidence  a critical factor for capital that values stability over hype

While competitors may offer faster speeds or lower fees in isolation, Ethereum’s strength comes from its holistic ecosystem. It is where liquidity concentrates, where standards are set, and where innovation becomes sustainable rather than temporary. History suggests that platforms with these characteristics tend to dominate over time, even if their growth appears gradual.
In conclusion, Ethereum represents the backbone of decentralized innovation. Price cycles will come and go, narratives will rotate, and new chains will emerge, but Ethereum’s role as a neutral, secure, and programmable settlement layer continues to deepen. For those looking beyond short-term volatility, ETH stands as one of the most strategically important assets in the digital economy not because it promises instant gains, but because it underpins the future of on-chain finance itself.

继续用主流币和山寨币来区分接下来的加密投资逻辑，其实已经不成立了。这个划分方式，本质上是早期投机周期留下的残余框架。

事实上，链上已经出现了一批拥有长期有效收益模型的应用型协议，它们不依赖叙事轮动，也不完全受制于情绪周期，而是通过真实使用、手续费与网络效应持续产生价值。

例如Hyper、AAVE、SKY、Ldo、link、Polymarket等协议，已经在各自的细分领域中建立起稳定的经济闭环。其中尤其是Hype与 Polymarket，正在正面挑战由中心化交易所长期主导的核心金融功能，其增长速度与用户渗透曲线，用夸张来形容并不为过。

以后的加密投资逻辑，将越来越接近于基础设施与应用层价值的再定价，而不是简单的主流或山寨轮动游戏。

链上应用所展现出的潜力与快速扩张，是送给新一代 Holder 最重要的一份礼物。随着监管约束的强化以及链上协议之间的竞争加剧，中心化交易所对市场整体定价与节奏的影响力，注定会被持续削弱。

接下来的周期里，就不要活在过去投机的旧框架里，机构散户都会随着市场成熟改变自己的资金配置逻辑。

title: Почему давление на ETH ослабевает, несмотря на негатив
subTitle:
$ETH 12H
Рынок сейчас активно пугают, но именно в такие моменты ликвидность обычно начинают собирать те, кто мыслит хладнокровно.
Несмотря на поток негатива, сам график выглядит заметно спокойнее, чем новостной фон. Паника есть в заголовках, но не в структуре цены.
Ключевой уровень 2735$ устоял. Поддержка не была проломлена, цена осталась внутри формации. Это важный сигнал - давление со стороны продавцов постепенно ослабевает.
Отдельно обращаю внимание на сближение с MA100 на 12H, примерно в районе 3230$. Это не разворот за один импульс, но явный признак того, что нисходящее движение теряет силу. Продажи на этих уровнях выглядят запоздалыми.
Данные по рынку труда - только часть картины. Реакция не обязана быть мгновенной. Крупные участники сначала заканчивают январский ребаланс, и лишь потом принимают решения.
Больше ясности рынок получит после публикации CPI в четверг. Именно тогда у ФРС будет полный набор вводных, а участники начнут пересматривать риски.
Страх на рынке сохраняется - и это нормально. Мы всё ещё находимся в фазе капитуляции, когда большинство боится нажимать кнопку buy. Как раз в таких условиях и формируются сильные базы.
⚠️ При спокойном и взвешенном подходе оптимальный сценарий выглядит так:
• дождаться четверга
• работать от зоны интереса покупателей 3026$ - 2735$

🎯 Если текущая структура сохранится, потенциал движения просматривается в сторону ближайшего серьёзного сопротивления 3746$ - 4073$.
Рынок любит забирать ликвидность у нетерпеливых. Сейчас больше подходит время расчёта, а не эмоций.

title: 各位巨鲸注意：这不是看涨看跌的问题，这是“谁在控节奏、谁在吃筹码”的问题。
subTitle:
今天盘面给出的信号很清晰——上面在打架，下面在换手，真正的筹码在暗处完成交接。
先把核心矛盾摆在台面上：$BTC 方向偏空，但不是那种一路砸穿的“单边空”，而是更阴的打法——制造多空混战。意思是：价格上去就压、下去就托，反复拉扯，让追多追空的人都变成燃料。你在盘面里感受到的“怎么都不顺”，本质就是对手盘在用波动做收割，用震荡做换手。

关键点来了：巨鲸多头持仓这条线，最近是明显抬升的，且抬升方式不是“冲一下就结束”，而是持续上台阶。巨鲸在加码，说明什么？说明他们不怕短期震荡，怕的是拿不到筹码。换句话说，盘面越乱，越适合把筹码从情绪盘里剥离出来——这就是“混战”的真正目的：把筹码交到更有耐心的人手里。

再看M2流动性：之前冲到高位后进入平台，今天出现回落迹象。流动性边际走弱的时候，最常见的走势不是立刻崩，而是“高位难涨、低位难跌”，用横盘+急杀急拉去完成结构转换。你会看到：一边巨鲸在拿，另一边盘面却故意表现出“不舒服”。这是典型的“控节奏行情”——不给你顺风，只给你耐心。

Gamma墙这块也在配合：柱子结构显示上下两侧都在立墙，市场做市商更倾向于把价格锁在一个区间里反复摩擦，逼出杠杆、逼出情绪。对巨鲸来说，这不是坏事：墙越厚，越说明价格被“规划”过；你要做的不是跟着情绪跑，而是盯着墙后的资金意图——什么时候压制松手、什么时候支撑撤走。

最后落到风险因子：风险评分回到大约3附近，代表它从“极端不可碰”回到了“可交易但不舒服”的状态。注意这句话的重点：可交易≠适合重仓。现在盘面更像“猎场”，不是“高速路”。庄家在混战，流动性边际回落，做市墙在控波动——任何重杠杆追方向，都是把命门递出去。

巨鲸该怎么做？一句话：只在“确定性出现”时放大仓位，其余时间用结构管理风险。
真正的巨鲸操作一般只有三种：
1）现货/低杠杆底仓不动，把震荡当成换筹过程；
2）合约只做对冲和节奏，不做梭哈方向——该避险就避险；
3）等盘面出现“压制失效”的那一刻再加速：价格不再一冲就被按回、回撤有人主动承接、波动从“乱”变成“顺”。
结论给得更直白一点：庄家在空头框架下打混战，短线是用来收割的；巨鲸持仓抬升说明筹码在被重新分配；M2回落意味着别指望一路无脑上冲；Gamma墙控波动意味着大概率还要磨人。这个阶段，能赢的不是“方向预言家”，而是“仓位管理者”。
仅供研究交流，不构成任何投资建议。

title: BEAT 死叉炸场！2.82 就是诱多屠宰点，1.24 这深渊今天就见？
subTitle:
大家好！我是紫檀！
今天粉丝村彻底炸了，全是问 BEAT 后续走势的，不少人盯着 4 小时图里那根慢涨的线，手痒得想往里冲，又怕一进场就被套牢，这纠结的心态我太懂了。
咱们直接点透当前的局：现在的 BEAT，就是场撑着面子的多头饭局，看着人模人样，其实没几个真掏钱包买单的。

先看 MACD 信号：黄白线还赖在 0 轴上方，但死叉已经明晃晃地摆着了。这不是空头抡着棒子砸盘的急跌，是多头自己泄了劲，本来是他们的主场，结果内部接不上力，等于自己人先松了弦，典型的温水煮青蛙，等你反应过来想跑，早陷进去了。
再看量能：价格慢悠悠往上磨，成交量要么缩成芝麻粒，要么纹丝不动，这叫量价背离，说白就是假涨。没人真金白银往里砸，这价格就是少数资金在那撑场面，跟个空架子似的，风一吹就塌。
关键价位我给你们划死了：往上看，3.45 是焊死的铁顶，2.82 是最近的一道坎，碰一下都得费死劲；往下看，1.9 是短期的命根子，撑不住就奔 1.24 的深渊，现在这位置，往上每走一步都是撞墙。

我的判断没半点含糊：现在 BEAT 冲高，就是最后逃命的机会，回调是板上钉钉的事。今天想直接冲 2.82 甚至摸 3.45？概率比中彩票还低。没量能撑着的死叉上涨，就是明着 “诱多”—— 让散户觉得趋势还在，傻乎乎进去接盘。去年有个币种就是这走势：死叉 + 缩量慢涨，最后从 2.3 直接砸到 1.1，套了一堆追涨的散户。
更大的可能是：价格在当前位置稍微蹦跶一下，立马掉头往下砸，先去测 1.9 的支撑强度。要是 1.9 守不住，市场情绪一崩，直奔 1.24 也不是没可能。
玩家现在就两种靠谱做法：
已经持仓且仓位重的，等价格靠近 2.82 的时候减一部分仓，别贪，之前有粉丝就是贪那几个点，从盈利直接变套牢；
还没进场的，别追涨，耐着性子等回调。要是跌到 1.9 附近稳住了，可以小仓位试水，但记住：分批买，仓位轻，别一把梭。
不管你选哪种，止损必须带好，别等跌破关键位了才拍大腿，到时候哭都没地方哭。

Hello everyone! I am Zitan!
Today, the fan community completely exploded, all asking about the subsequent movement of BEAT. Many are staring at that slowly rising line in the 4-hour chart, itching to dive in, but fearing getting stuck as soon as they enter. I totally understand this conflicted mindset.
Let's get straight to the point: the current BEAT is just a posh banquet for the bulls, looking good on the surface, but there aren't many actually willing to reach for their wallets.

First, look at the MACD signals: the yellow and white lines are still lingering above the 0 axis, but the death cross is glaringly present. This isn't a sharp drop caused by bears swinging their bat; it's the bulls losing their momentum. Originally their home turf, they can't keep the pressure up internally, which is like a teammate loosening the string first. It's a classic case of boiling frogs; by the time you realize and want to escape, you're already trapped.

translatedData.content:
【ETH These K lines are out, the intention is no longer hidden】

Sitting down seriously to look at the market in the evening, I am starting to feel something with ETH lately.

Watching ETH's K lines these past few days, some details are indeed slowly surfacing. The current price is stuck at 2927.74, neither going up nor down, but precisely this seemingly sluggish trend has made this old holder like me more vigilant. RSI is stuck at 48.4, neither overbought nor oversold, as if waiting for some signal. The trend is clearly in a state of consolidation and accumulation, and the trading volume has not suddenly increased, indicating that the main force is not yet ready to reveal their cards.

One possibility is that this horizontal range is a washout action before a new round of upward movement. Look at the previous few K lines, the lower shadows occasionally pop up, and the selling pressure is caught each time at a certain position, as if there is capital quietly supporting below. If this is the case, once there is a breakout with volume past the consolidation range, there may be a decent upward surge. Especially since the market sentiment has not collapsed recently; even if the overall market does not move, ETH, as the leading player, can easily create an independent trend.

But we cannot be too optimistic. Another possibility is that this wave of consolidation is actually a sign of the exhaustion of upward momentum. RSI has not entered the overbought territory, but it has not clearly turned upward, indicating that buying power is not strong. If we cannot even reach higher points next, it is likely to continue dragging sideways, and we cannot rule out another small pullback to shake off floating chips. This situation is also common in bull markets; after significant rises without deep corrections, it relies on time to create space.

So it is really hard to say where it will go now. Personally, I tend to be cautiously optimistic, after all, the fundamentals and ecological enthusiasm of ETH have not cooled down, and on-chain activities are still active. As long as the key support is not broken, this consolidation seems more like preparation for the next step. However, that said, we still need to control our positions; don’t impulsively chase just because it looks like it’s about to move. As an old holder who has survived to now, what I rely on is not aggression, but stability.

【ETH 这几根 K 线摆出来，意图已经不太藏了】

晚上坐下来认真看盘，ETH这段开始有点感觉了。

这几天盯着ETH的K线看，确实有些细节慢慢浮出水面。当前价格停在2927.74这个位置，不上不下，但恰恰是这种看似磨叽的走势，反而让我这种老韭菜多留了个心眼。RSI卡在48.4，既不超买也不超卖，像是在等什么信号。趋势上明显是震荡蓄力的状态，成交量也没突然放大，说明主力还没打算亮底牌。

一种可能是，这根横盘的区间就是新一轮上涨前的洗盘动作。你看前面几根K线，下影线时不时冒出来一下，砸盘的力度每次到某个位置就被接住，像是有资金在下方悄悄托着。如果真是这样，那接下来一旦放量突破盘整带，可能会有一波像样的上冲。尤其是近期市场情绪没崩，哪怕大盘不动，ETH这种带头大哥也容易自己走出独立行情。

但也不能太乐观。另一种情况是，这波震荡其实是上涨动能衰竭的表现。RSI没进超买，但也没明显拐头向上，说明买方力量并不强。如果接下来连高点都摸不动，那很可能继续横向拖时间，甚至不排除再来一波小幅回调，把浮动筹码再甩一甩。这种情况其实在牛市里也常见，涨多了不深调，就靠时间换空间。

所以现在真不好说一定往哪走。但我个人更偏谨慎乐观一点，毕竟ETH的基本面和生态热度没冷下来，链上活动也还活跃。只要不破关键支撑，这种震荡更像是为下一步做准备。不过话说回来，仓位该控还是得控，别因为看着像要动了就冲动追。咱老韭菜活到现在，靠的不是猛，是稳。

title: #AAVE : LA PLUS GROSSE NOUVELLE
subTitle:
#Aave entame un nouveau chapitre alors que l’incertitude réglementaire s’estompe enfin. Stani Kulechov, fondateur et PDG du protocole, a dévoilé une feuille de route allant jusqu’en 2026, détaillant les axes de croissance et d’innovation après une année 2025 marquante. Cette annonce intervient à la suite de la clôture par la Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) américaine d’une enquête de quatre ans visant Aave, levant ainsi un obstacle majeur et permettant au protocole de se concentrer pleinement sur sa prochaine phase de développement. Libéré de la pression réglementaire, Aave entend désormais capitaliser sur sa forte dynamique, améliorer ses produits, accélérer l’adoption et renforcer sa présence sur le marché.

Salle de guerre futuriste avec un stratège d'Aave lançant une fusée sur la feuille de route numérique 2026.
Lisez-nous sur Google News
En bref

Aave entre dans une nouvelle phase de croissance après la clôture par la SEC d’une enquête de quatre ans, levant les incertitudes réglementaires.
Le protocole prévoit le lancement de V4, l’extension de Horizon pour les actifs réels et l’introduction de l’application Aave afin de simplifier l’accès à la DeFi.
Une année 2025 record positionne Aave en leader du marché, avec 75 milliards de dollars de dépôts nets et près de 1 trillion de dollars de prêts émis.
Aave V4 et la voie vers une croissance de niveau supérieur

Stani Kulechov a souligné que, bien qu’Aave soit devenu la plus grande et la plus fiable plateforme de prêt de la finance décentralisée, le projet n’en est encore qu’à ses débuts. Les chiffres actuels, aussi impressionnants soient-ils, ne représentent selon lui qu’une fraction du potentiel réel du protocole.

Le PDG a présenté trois priorités principales pour l’année à venir, à commencer par Aave V4. Cette refonte complète du protocole vise à positionner « Aave comme la colonne vertébrale de toute la finance ». Elle abandonne les pools de liquidité isolés au profit d’une architecture de type hub-and-spoke, centralisant la liquidité sur chaque réseau tout en permettant la création de marchés de prêt personnalisés via des spokes dédiés.

Selon Kulechov, cette approche permettra à Aave de gérer des billions de dollars d’actifs, faisant du protocole un choix privilégié pour les banques, les institutions financières technologiques et les entreprises souhaitant accéder à une liquidité profonde et fiable.

En 2026, Aave accueillera de nouveaux marchés, de nouveaux actifs et de nouvelles intégrations qui n’ont jamais existé auparavant dans la DeFi.

Stani Kulechov
Aave élargit l’accès avec Horizon et son application

La seconde priorité concerne Horizon, introduit plus tôt cette année comme un pont vers le prochain trillion de dollars. Cette plateforme est dédiée aux actifs réels institutionnels et permet à des entités approuvées d’utiliser des actifs tokenisés comme garantie pour accéder à des prêts en stablecoins.

Horizon affiche actuellement 550 millions de dollars de dépôts nets. Aave ambitionne de dépasser le milliard de dollars d’ici 2026, en s’appuyant sur des partenariats avec Circle, Ripple, Franklin Templeton et VanEck. Cette initiative pourrait porter la base totale d’actifs adressables du protocole à plus de 500 trillions de dollars.

Kulechov a déclaré : « Aave ne peut jouer un rôle central dans l’ensemble du système financier sans intégrer les actions, ETF, fonds, immobilier, hypothèques, matières premières, créances, obligations et revenus fixes dans le prêt on-chain. Horizon positionne Aave pour y parvenir. »

Le troisième pilier de la stratégie d’Aave repose sur l’application Aave, une plateforme mobile conçue pour simplifier l’usage de la finance décentralisée pour le grand public. En masquant la complexité technique et en proposant une interface claire et intuitive, l’application vise à attirer le prochain million d’utilisateurs. Le déploiement complet est prévu pour le début de l’année prochaine, ouvrant l’accès à une nouvelle base d’utilisateurs et soutenant la croissance du protocole. L’adoption massive au niveau du produit est considérée comme un levier clé pour atteindre des encours de plusieurs billions de dollars.

Croissance record et leadership sur le marché

En parallèle, Aave a franchi plusieurs jalons majeurs en 2025, avec des performances particulièrement remarquables :

Le protocole a atteint 75 milliards de dollars de dépôts nets et traité un total de 3,33 trillions de dollars de dépôts depuis son lancement il y a cinq ans, tout en émettant près de 1 trillion de dollars de prêts.
Sa taille rivalise désormais avec celle des 50 plus grandes banques américaines, captant 59 % du marché des prêts DeFi et 61 % des prêts actifs de la finance décentralisée.
Aave a généré 885 millions de dollars de frais de prêt cette année, soit plus de la moitié des frais totaux issus des protocoles de lending.
Les revenus du protocole dépassent le total cumulé de ses cinq concurrents les plus proches, confirmant sa domination du marché.

Treemap showing top lending projects by fees, with Aave leading at 52.3%.

🌐 Title:
Ethereum wobbles: ETH breaks the 2,800 USDT support and triggers market alarms

---

On a day marked by volatility, Ethereum (ETH) surprised traders by falling below 2,800 USDT, a level that many considered key to maintaining confidence in the second largest asset of the crypto ecosystem. The break of support not only generated quick sales on exchanges but also created an atmosphere of uncertainty reflected in social media and trading communities.

The movement came after a series of liquidations in leveraged positions, which intensified downward pressure. Analysts point out that the lack of buying volume and the correlation with Bitcoin's decline were determining factors. "The market is showing signs of fatigue, and ETH failed to hold the psychological barrier of 2,800," commented a trader on Binance Futures.

The reaction was immediate: some retail investors chose to exit their positions, while more experienced ones see the correction as an opportunity to accumulate. On Telegram and Twitter, memes about the fall mingled with risk warnings, reflecting the human and emotional tone that characterizes the crypto ecosystem.

The short-term outlook will depend on whether Ethereum can regain ground towards 2,900–3,000 USDT, or if the downward pressure drags it to deeper levels. The truth is that the fall rekindled the debate about the market's fragility and reminded everyone that, in the world of cryptocurrencies, calm can be broken in a matter of minutes. #ETH

title:

subTitle:
US$3.000 karena Keyakinan Holder Menurun
Harga Ethereum kembali mengalami tekanan setelah gagal breakout dari tren turun selama dua bulan terakhir. ETH sempat mencoba pulih minggu lalu, tapi langsung kehilangan momentum.
Dukungan investor yang lemah mendorong Ethereum semakin turun, sehingga muncul kekhawatiran tentang kemampuannya untuk mempertahankan pemulihan yang berarti dalam waktu dekat.
Ethereum Mulai Kehilangan Dukungan dari Investor
Data on-chain menunjukkan bahwa tingkat keuntungan baik bagi holder jangka panjang maupun jangka pendek telah menurun. Saat ini, kedua kelompok berada pada level profitabilitas yang mirip, sehingga menandakan keyakinan di pasar makin menurun. Konvergensi ini memperlihatkan tak ada satu kelompok pun yang meraih keuntungan signifikan pada harga saat ini.
Perbedaan MVRV Long/Short juga turun ke bawah garis nol dan memperkuat tren ini. Angka ini menunjukkan baik holder jangka panjang maupun jangka pendek sama-sama tidak memegang profit tak terealisasi yang dominan. Jika indikator ini turun lebih jauh, keuntungan holder jangka pendek Ethereum bisa mendominasi, sehingga meningkatkan risiko penurunan dan menggambarkan sentimen investor yang rapuh.
Ingin update token seperti ini? Daftar untuk Newsletter Harian Crypto dari Editor Harsh Notariya di sini.
Aktivitas makro pada Ethereum juga terlihat semakin melemah. Jumlah alamat aktif di jaringan turun ke level terendah dalam tujuh bulan. Penurunan ini mencerminkan berkurangnya partisipasi dari holder ETH, sehingga menandakan interaksi dengan jaringan pun ikut menurun di tengah lemahnya harga.
Aktivitas yang lebih rendah ini menunjukkan investor melihat insentif yang terbatas untuk bertransaksi di tengah harga yang cenderung sideways. Penurunan penggunaan jaringan sering kali menandakan kepercayaan yang mulai luntur. Tanpa permintaan baru atau dorongan dari faktor tertentu, Ethereum sepertinya akan sulit mendapatkan momentum dalam waktu dekat.
ETH saat ini diperdagangkan di US$2.929, yang menandai penurunan ketiga kalinya di bawah US$3.000 bulan ini. Upaya breakout harga Ethereum awal pekan lalu gagal bertahan. Penolakan ini memperkuat tren turun yang ada dan menunjukkan minat beli yang minim di level lebih tinggi.
Indikator bearish mengisyaratkan Ethereum bisa retest support di US$2.762. Zona ini secara historis menjadi batas bawah yang penting. Meski tekanan turun masih ada, penurunan yang lebih dalam sepertinya terbatas kecuali kondisi pasar secara umum memburuk secara signifikan.
Perubahan sentimen investor bisa saja mengubah prospek Ethereum. Mengamankan level US$3.000 sebagai support tetap menjadi kunci utama. Jika ETH bisa bertahan secara konsisten di atas level ini, ETH berpotensi menantang area US$3.131. Pemulihan seperti itu bisa membatalkan skenario bearish dan menjadi sinyal breakout dari tren turun.
